##### *[PTS Page 083]*

ṭiññaṃ[^083-1] mocessāmīti" Rājagahanagarūpacāre Laṭṭhivanuyyānaṃ[^083-2] agamāsi. Rājā uyyānapālassa santikā "Satthā āgāto" ti sutvā dvādasanahutehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi parivuto Satthāraṃ upasaṃkamitvā cakkavicittatalesu suvaṇṇapaṭavitānaṃ viya pabhāsamudayaṃ vissajjentesu[^083-2] Tathāgatassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi saddhiṃ parisāya. Atha kho tesaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ etad ahosi: "kin nu kho Mahāsamaṇo[^083-4] Uruvelakassape brahmacariyaṃ carati udāhu Uruvelakassapo Mahāsamaṇe[^083-5]" ti. Bhagavā tesaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya[^083-6] theraṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi: JaNi_282:  "Kim eva disvā Uruvelavāsi pahāsi aggiṃ kisako vadāno, pucchāmi taṃ Kassapa etam atthaṃ: kathaṃ pahīnaṃ tava aggihuttan" ti. Thero pi Bhagavato adhippāyaṃ viditvā JaNi_283:  Rūpe ca sadde ca atho rase ca kāmitthiyo cābhivadanti[^083-7] yaññaṃ[^083-8], etaṃ malan ti upadhīsu ñatvā tasmā na yiṭṭhe na hute araṃjin ti imaṃ gāthaṃ vatvā attano sāvakabhāvappakāsanatthaṃ Tathāgatassa pādapiṭṭhe sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā "satthā me bhante Bhagavā, sāvako 'haṃ asmīti" vatvā ekatālaṃ dvitālaṃ titālan ti yāva sattatālappamāṇaṃ sattakkhattuṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā oruyha Tathāgataṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Taṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā mahājano "aho mahānubhāvā Buddhā, evaṃ thāmagatadiṭṭhiko[^083-9] nāma ‘arahā'; ti maññamāno Uruvelakassapo pi diṭṭhijālam bhinditvā Tathāgatena damito" ti Satthu guṇakathaṃ yeva kathesi. Bhagavā "nāhaṃ idānim eva Uruvelakassapaṃ damemi, atīte pi esa mayā damito yevā" 'ti vatvā imissā aṭṭhuppaṭṭiyā Mahānāradakassapajātakaṃ kathetvā cattāri saccāni pakāsesi. Magadharājā ekādasahi nahutehi saddhiṃ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi, ekaṃ nahutaṃ upāsakattaṃ paṭivedesi.

Rājā satthu santike nisinno yeva pañca assāsake pavedetvā saraṇaṃ gantvā svātanāya nimantetvā āsanā vuṭṭhāya Bhagavantaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. Punadivase yehi ca Bhagavā diṭṭho yehi ca adiṭṭho sabbe pi Rājagahavāsino aṭṭhārasakoṭisaṃkhā manussā Tathāgataṃ daṭṭhukāmā pāto va Rājagahato Laṭṭhivanaṃ agamaṃsu. Tigāvutamaggo na-ppahosi. Sakalalaṭṭhivanuyyānaṃ nirantaraṃ puṭaṃ[^084-1] ahosi. Mahājano Dasabalassa rūpaggappattaṃ attabhāvaṃ passanto tittiṃ kātuṃ nāsakkhi. Vaṇṇabhū[^084-2] nām'; esā, evarūpesu hi ṭhānesu Tathāgatassa lakkhaṇānubyañjanādippabhedā[^084-3] sabbāpi rūpakāyasiriṃ[^084-4] vaṇṇetabbā. Evaṃ rūpaggappattaṃ Dasabalassa sarīraṃ passamānena mahājanena nirantaraṃ puṭe[^084-5] uyyāne ca magge ca ekabhikkhussāpi nikkhamanokāso nāhosi. Taṃ divasaṃ kira "Bhagavā chinnabhatto bhaveyya, taṃ mā ahosīti" Sakkassa nisinnāsanaṃ uṇhākāraṃ dassesi. So āvajjamāno taṃ kāraṇaṃ ñatvā māṇavakavaṇṇaṃ[^084-6] abhinimminitvā[^084-7] Buddha-Dhamma-Saṃgha-paṭisaṃyuttathutiyo[^084-8] vadamāno Dasabalassa purato otaritvā devānubhāvena[^084-9] okāsaṃ katvā JaNi_284:  "Danto dantehi saha purāṇajaṭilehi vippamuttehi[^084-10] siṅgīnikkhasavaṇṇo Rājagahaṃ pavisi Bhagavā. JaNi_285/286:  Mutto muttehi --pe--. Tiṇṇo tiṇṇehi --pe--. JaNi_287:  Dasāvāso Dasabalo dasadhammavidū[^084-11] dasahi c'; upeto so dasasataparivāro Rājagaham[^084-12] pāvisi Bhagavā" ti imāhi gāthāhi Satthu vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno purato pāyāsi. Mahājano māṇavakassa[^084-13] rūpasiriṃ disvā "ativiya abhirūpo ayaṃ māṇavako[^084-14], na kho pan'; amhehi diṭṭhapubbo" ti cintetvā "kuto ayaṃ māṇavako[^084-15], kassa vā ayan" ti āha. Taṃ sutvā māṇavo[^084-16] JaNi_288:  Yo dhīro sabbadhī danto Buddho appaṭipuggalo arahaṃ sugato loke tassāhaṃ paricārako[^084-17]" ti gāthaṃ āha. Satthā Sakkena katokāsaṃ maggaṃ paṭipajjitvā

##### *[PTS Page 085]*

bhikkhusahassaparivuto Rājagaham[^085-1] pāvisi. Rājā buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa mahādānaṃ datvā "ahaṃ bhante tīṇi[^085-2] ratanāni vinā vattituṃ na sakkhissāmi, velāya vā avelāya vā Bhagavato santikaṃ āgamissāmi, Laṭṭhivanuyyānañ ca nāma atidūre idam[^085-3] pan'; amhākaṃ Veḷuvanaṃ nāma uyyānaṃ nātidūre, gamanāgamanasampannaṃ buddhārahaṃ senāsanaṃ idaṃ me Bhagavā patigaṇhatū[^085-1]" ti suvaṇṇabhiṃkārena[^085-4] pupphagandhavāsitamaṇivaṇṇaudakaṃ ādāya Veḷuvanuyyānaṃ pariccajanto Dasabalassa hatthe udakaṃ pātesi. Tasmiṃ ārāmapaṭiggahaṇe[^085-5] Buddhasāsanassa mūlāni otiṇṇānīti mahāpaṭhavī[^085-6] kampi. Jambudīpasmiṃ[^085-7] hi ṭhapetvā Veḷuvanaṃ aññaṃ[^085-8] paṭhaviṃ kampetvā gahitasenāsanaṃ nāma n'; atthi. Tambapaṇṇidīpe pi ṭhapetvā Mahāvihāraṃ aññaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampetvā gahitasenāsanaṃ nāma n'; atthi. Satthā veḷuvanārāmaṃ paṭiggahetvā rañño anumodanaṃ katvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto Veḷuvanaṃ agamāsi. Tasmiṃ kho pana samaye Sāriputto ca Moggallāno cā 'ti dve paribbājakā Rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharanti amataṃ pariyesamānā. Tesu Sāriputto Assajitheraṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhaṃ disvā pasannacitto payirupāsitvā "ye dhammā hetuppabhavā" ti gāthaṃ sutvā sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāya sahāyakassa Moggallānaparibbājakassāpi tam eva gāthaṃ abhāsi. So pi sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahi. Te ubho pi Sañjayaṃ oloketvā attano parisāya saddhiṃ Satthu santike pabbajiṃsu. Tesu Mahāmoggallāno sattāhena arahattaṃ pāpuṇi Sāriputtatthero addhamāsena, ubho pi ca ne Satthā aggasāvakaṭṭhāne ṭhapesi. Sāriputtattherena arahattapattadivase yeva sāvakasannipātam akāsi. Tathāgate pana tasmiñ[^085-9] ñeva Veḷuvanuyyāne viharante Suddhodanamahārājā "putto kira me chabbassāni dukkarakārikaṃ caritvā paramābhisambodhiṃ patvā pavattavaradhammacakko Rājagahaṃ nissāya Veḷuvane viharatīti" sutvā aññataraṃ[^085-10] amaccaṃ āmantesi: "ehi bhaṇe purisasahassaparivāro Rājagahaṃ gantvā mama vacanena ‘pitā vo Suddhodanamahārājā daṭṭhukāmo'; ti vatvā puttam me[^085-11] gaṇhitvā ehīti" āha. So "evaṃ devā" 'ti rañño vacanaṃ sirasā sampaṭicchitvā purisasahassaparivāro khippam eva saṭṭhiyojanamaggaṃ gantvā Dasabalassa catuparisamajjhe nisīditvā dhammadesanavelāya vihāraṃ pāvisi. So "tiṭṭhatu tāva rañño[^085-12] pahitasāsanan" ti parisante ṭhito Satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā yathāṭhito va saddhiṃ purisasa-

hassena arahattaṃ patvā pabbajjaṃ yāci. Bhagavā "etha bhikkhavo" ti hatthaṃ pasāresi. Sabbe taṃ khaṇaṃ yeva iddhimayapattacīvaradharā vassasatikatherā viya ahesuṃ. Arahattaṃ pattakālato paṭṭhāya pana ariyā nāma majjhattā[^086-1] va hontīti rañño pahitasāsanaṃ Dasabalassa na kathesi. Rājā "n'; eva gatako va[^086-2] āgacchati na sāsanaṃ sūyatīti "ehi bhaṇe tvaṃ gacchā" 'ti ten'; eva niyāmena aññaṃ[^086-3] amaccaṃ pesesi. So pi gantvā purimanayen'; eva saddhiṃ parisāya arahattaṃ patvā tuṇhī[^086-4] ahosi. Rājā eten'; eva niyāmena purisasahassaparivāre nava[^086-5] amacce pesesi. Sabbe attano kiccaṃ niṭṭhapetvā tuṇhī bhūtā tatth' eva vihariṃsu. Rājā sāsanamattakam pi āharitvā ācikkhantaṃ alabhitvā cintesi: "ettakā janā mayi sinehabhāvena[^086-6] sāsanamattam pi na paccāhariṃsu, ko nu kho me vacanaṃ karissatīti sabbaṃ rājabalaṃ olokento Kāḷudāyiṃ addasa. So kira rañño[^086-7] sabbatthasādhako abbhantariko ativissāsiko Bodhisattena saddhiṃ ekadivase jāto sahapaṃsukīḷito[^086-8] sahāyo. Atha naṃ rājā āmantesi: "tāta Kāḷudāyi, ahaṃ mama puttaṃ passitukāmo nava purisasahassāni pesesiṃ, ekapuriso pi āgantvā sāsanamattaṃ ārocetvāpi n'; atthi, dujjāno kho pana jīvitantarāyo, ahaṃ jīvamāno va puttaṃ daṭṭhuṃ icchāmi, sakkhissati[^086-9] nu kho me puttaṃ dassetun" ti "Sakkhissāmi deva sace pabbajituṃ labhissāmīti". "Tāta tvam pabbajitvā vā apabbajitvā vā mayhaṃ puttaṃ dassehīti". So "sādhu devā" 'ti rañño[^086-7] sāsanaṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ gantvā Satthu dhammadesanavelāya parisapariyante ṭhito dhammaṃ sutvā saparivāro arahattaphalaṃ patvā ehibhikkhubhāve patiṭṭhāsi[^086-10]. Satthā Buddho hutvā paṭhamaṃ antovassaṃ Isipatane vasitvā vutthavasso[^086-11] pavāretvā Uruvelaṃ gantvā tattha tayo māse vasanto tebhātikajaṭile vinetvā bhikkhusahassaparivāro Phussamāsapuṇṇamāya Rājāgahaṃ gantvā dve māse vasi. Ettāvatā Bārāṇasito nikkhantassa[^086-12] pañca māsā jātā. Sakalo hemanto atikkanto, Udāyittherassa āgatadivasato sattaṭṭhadivasā vītivattā. So Phaggunipuṇṇamāsiyaṃ[^086-13] cintesi: "atikkanto hemanto, vasantasamayo anuppatto, manussehi sassādīni uddharitvā sammukhaṭṭhāne maggā dinnā, haritatiṇasañchannā[^086-14] paṭhavī, supupphitā vanasaṇḍā, paṭipajjanakkhamā maggā, kālo Dasabalassa ñātisaṃgaham kātun" ti. Atha Bhagavantaṃ upasaṃkamitvā

JaNi_289:  "Aṅgārino[^087-1] dāni dumā bhadante phalesino chadanaṃ vippahāya, te accimanto va pabhāsayanti. samayo Mahāvīra bhagī rasānaṃ. JaNi_290:  Nātisītaṃ nātiuṇhaṃ nātidubbhikkhachātakaṃ[^087-2], saddalā haritā bhūmi, esa kālo Mahāmunīti" saṭṭhimattāhi[^087-3] gāthāhi Dasabalassa kulanagaragamanatthāya gamanavaṇṇaṃ vaṇṇesi. Atha naṃ Satthā "kin nu kho Udāyi madhurassarena gamanavaṇṇaṃ vaṇṇesīti" āha. "Bhante tumhākaṃ pitā Suddhodanamahārājā passitukāmo, karothā ñātakānaṃ saṃgahan[^087-4]" ti. "Sādhu Udāyi, karissāmi ñātakānaṃ saṃgahaṃ, bhikkhusaṃghassa ārocehi, gamiyavattaṃ pūressantīti". "Sādhu bhante ti thero ārocesi. Bhagavā Aṅga-Magadha-vāsīnaṃ[^087-5] kulaputtānaṃ dasahi sahassehi Kapilavatthuvāsīnaṃ dasahi sahassehīti sabbeh'; eva vīsatisahassehi khīṇāsavabhikkhūhi parivuto Rājagahā nikkhamitvā divase divase[^087-6] yojanaṃ gacchati. "Rājagahato saṭṭhiyojanaṃ Kapilavattuṃ dvīhi[^087-7] māsehi pāpuṇissāmīti" aturitacārikaṃ pakkāmi. Thero pi "Bhagavato nikkhantabhāvaṃ rañño[^087-8] ārocessāmīti" vehāsam abbhuggantvā rañño[^087-8] nivesane pātur ahosi. Rājā theraṃ disvā tuṭṭhacitto mahārahe pallaṃke nisīdāpetvā attano paṭiyāditassa nānaggarasabhojanassa pattaṃ pūretvā adāsi. Thero uṭṭhāya gamanākāraṃ dassesi. "Nisīditvā bhuñjathā" 'ti. "Satthu santikaṃ gantvā bhuñjissāmi mahārājā" 'ti. "Kahaṃ pana Satthā" ti. "Vīsatibhikkhusahassaparivāro tumhākaṃ dassanatthāya cārikaṃ nikkhanto mahārājā" 'ti. Rājā tuṭṭhamānaso āha: "tumhe imaṃ paribhuñjitvā yāva mama putto imaṃ nagaraṃ pāpuṇāti tāv'; assa ito va piṇḍapātaṃ pariharathā" 'ti. Thero adhivāsesi. Rājā theraṃ parivisitvā pattaṃ gandhacuṇṇena ubbaṭṭetvā uttamabhojanassa pūretvā "Tathāgatassa dethā" 'ti therassa hatthe patiṭṭhāpesi. Thero sabbesaṃ passantānaṃ[^087-9] yeva pattaṃ ākāse khipitvā sayam pi vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā Satthu hatthe ṭhapesi. Satthā taṃ paribhuñji. Eten'; upāyena thero divase divase āhari. Satthāpi antarāmagge rañño[^087-10] yeva piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñji. Thero pi bhattakiccāvasāne divase divase[^087-11] "ajja ettakaṃ Bhagavā āgato, ajja ettakan"

##### *[PTS Page 088]*

ti baddhaguṇapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca kathāya sakalarājakulaṃ Satthu dassanaṃ vinā yeva Satthari sañjātappasādaṃ akāsi. Ten'; eva naṃ Bhagavā "etadaggaṃ[^088-1] bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ[^088-2] kulappasādakānaṃ yadidaṃ Kāḷudāyīti" etadagge ṭhapesi. Sākiyāpi kho anuppatte Bhagavati "amhākaṃ ñātiseṭṭhaṃ passissāmā" 'ti sannipativā Bhagavato vasanaṭṭhānaṃ vīmaṇisamānā "Nigrodhasakkassa ārāmo ramaṇīyo[^088-3]" ti sallakkhetvā tattha sabbaṃ paṭijagganavidhiṃ kāretvā gandhapupphahatthā paccuggamanaṃ karontā sabbālaṃkārapatimaṇḍite daharadahare[^088-4] nāgaradārake ca dārikāyo ca paṭhamaṃ pahiṇiṃsu[^088-5], tato rājakumāre ca rājakumāriyo ca, tesaṃ anantaraṃ[^088-6] sāmaṃ gandhapupphacuṇṇādīhi pūjayamānā Bhagavantaṃ gahetvā Nigrodhārāmam eva gagamaṃsu. Tatra Bhagavā vīsatisahassakhīṇāsavaparivuto paññattavarabuddhāsane nisīdi. Sākiyā nāma mānajātikā mānatthaddhā. Te "Siddhatthakumāro amhehi daharataro amhākaṃ kaniṭṭho bhāgineyyo putto nattā" ti cintetvā daharadahare rājakumāre āhaṃsu: "tumhe vandathā, mayaṃ tumhākaṃ piṭṭhito nisīdissāmā" 'ti Tesu evaṃ nisinnesu Bhagavā tesaṃ ajjhāsayam oloketvā "na maṃ ñātayo vandati, handa dāni ne vandāpessāmīti" abhiññāpādakajjhānaṃ[^088-7] samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya ākāsaṃ abbhuggantvā tesaṃ sīse pādapaṃsuṃ okiramāno viya Gaṇḍambamūle yamakapāṭihāriyasadisaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ akāsi. Rājā taṃ[^088-8] acchariyaṃ disvā āha: "Bhagavā tumhākaṃ jātadivase Kāḷadevalassa vandanatthaṃ upanītānaṃ pāde vo parivattitvā brāhmaṇassa matthake patiṭṭhite disvāpi ahaṃ tumhe vandiṃ, ayam me paṭhamavandanā, vappamaṅgaladivase jambucchāyāya sirisayane nisinnānaṃ vo jambucchāyāya aparivattanaṃ disvāpi pāde vandiṃ, ayaṃ me dutiyā[^088-9] vandanā, idāni imaṃ adiṭṭhapubbaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ disvāpi tumhākaṃ pāde vandāmi, ayaṃ me tatiyā vandanā" ti. Rañño[^088-10] pana vandite Bhagavantaṃ avanditvā ṭhātuṃ samattho nāma eko Sākiyo pi nāhosi, sabbe vandiṃsu yeva. Iti Bhagavā ñātake vandāpetvā ākāsato otaritvā paññatte[^088-11] āsane nisīdi. Nisinne Bhagavati sikhāppatto ñātisamāgamo ahosi. Sabbe ekaggacittā hutvā nisīdiṃsu. Tato mahāmegho pokkharavassaṃ vassi, tambavaṇṇaṃ udakaṃ heṭṭhā viravantam gacchati, temitukāmo va temeti, atemitukāmassa sarīre udabindumatto pi na patati. Taṃ disvā sabbe acchariyabbhutacittajātā "aho acchariyaṃ aho abbhutan" ti kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpesuṃ. Satthā "na


<!-- PTS Page 089 -->
<a id="page-089"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 089]*

idānim eva mayhaṃ ñātisamāgame pokkharavassaṃ vassati, atīte pi vassīti" imissā aṭṭhuppattiyā Vessantarajātakaṃ kathesi. Dhammadesanaṃ sutvā sabbe uṭṭhāya vanditvā pakkamiṃsu, eko pi rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā "sve amhākaṃ bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā" 'ti vatvā gato nāma n'; atthi. Satthā punadivase vīsatisahassabhikkhuparivuto Kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. Taṃ na koci gantvā nimantesi vā pattaṃ vā aggahesi. Bhagavā indakhīle ṭhito va āvajjesi: "kathan nu kho pubbabuddhā kulanagare piṇḍāya cariṃsu, kiṃ uppaṭipāṭiyā issarajjanānam gharāni agamaṃsu[^089-1] udāhu sapadānacārikaṃ cariṃsū" 'ti. Tato ekabuddhassāpi uppaṭipāṭiyā gamanaṃ adisvā[^089-2] "mayāpi dāni ayam eva vaṃso ayaṃ me paveṇi[^089-3] paggahetabbā, āyatiñ ca me sāvakāpi mamañ[^089-4] ñeva anusikkhantā piṇḍacāriyavattaṃ paripūressantīti" koṭiyaṃ niviṭṭhagehato paṭṭhāya sapadānaṃ[^089-5] piṇḍāya cari. "Ayyo kira Siddhatthakumāro piṇḍāya caratīti dvibhūmakatibhūmakādisu[^089-6] pāsādesu sīhapañjare vivaritvā mahājano dassanavyāvaṭo ahosi. Rāhulamātāpi devī[^089-7] "ayyaputto kira imasmiṃ yeva nagare mahantena rājānubhāvena suvaṇṇasivikādīhi vicaritvā[^089-8] idāni kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyavatthavasano kapālahattho piṇḍāya carati, sobhati nu kho" ti sīhapañjaraṃ vivaritvā olokayamānā Bhagavantaṃ nānāvirāgasamujjalāya sarīrappabhāya nagaravīthiyo obhāsetvā vyāmappabhāparikkhepasamupabbūḷhāya[^089-9] asītānubyañjanāvabhāsitāya[^089-10] dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇapatimaṇḍitāya anopamāya Buddhasiriyā virocamānaṃ disvā JaNi_291:  "Siniddhanīlamudukuñcitakeso suriyasunimmalatalābhinalāṭo yuttatuṅgamudukāyatanāso raṃsijālavitato narasīho" ti evamādikāhi aṭṭhahi narasīhagāthāhi nāma abhitthavitvā "tumhākaṃ putto piṇḍāya caratīti" rañño[^089-11] ārocesi. Rājā saṃviggahadayo hatthena sāṭakaṃ saṇṭhapento turitaturitaṃ nikkhamitvā vegena gantvā Bhagavato purato ṭhatvā āha: "kiṃ bhante amhe lajjāpetha, kimatthaṃ piṇḍāya caratha, kiṃ ‘ettakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ na sakkā bhattaṃ laddhun'; ti


<!-- PTS Page 090 -->
<a id="page-090"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 090]*

saññaṃ[^090-1] karitthā" 'ti. "Cārittaṃ etaṃ[^090-2] mahārājā amhākan ti. "Nanu bhante amhākaṃ Mahāsammatakhattiyavaṃso nāma vaṃso, tattha ca ekakhattiyo pi bhikkhācāro nāma n'; atthīti". "Ayaṃ mahārāja rājavaṃso nāma tava vaṃso, amhākaṃ pana Dīpaṃkaro[^090-3] Koṇḍañño --pe-- Kassapo ti ayaṃ Buddhavaṃso nāma, ete ca aññe ca anekasahassasaṃkhā Buddhā bhikkhācārā bhikkhācāren'; eva jīvikaṃ kappesun" ti antaravīthiyaṃ[^090-4] ṭhito va JaNi_292:  "Uttiṭṭhe na-ppamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti asmiṃ loke paramhi ca" (Dhpd. v. 168.) imaṃ gātham āha. Gāthāpariyosāne rājā sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi. JaNi_293:  "Dhammaṃ care sucaritaṃ, na naṃ duccaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti asmiṃ loke paramhi cā" 'ti (Dhpd. v. 169.) imaṃ pana gāthaṃ sutvā sakadāgāmiphale patiṭṭhāsi. Dhammapālajātakaṃ sutvā anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhāsi. Maraṇasamaye setacchattassa heṭṭhā sirisayane nipanno yeva arahattaṃ[^090-5] pāpuṇi. Araññavāsena[^090-6] padhānānuyogakiccaṃ[^090-7] rañño[^090-8] nāhosi. Sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikatvā yeva pana Bhagavato pattaṃ gahetvā saparisaṃ Bhagavantaṃ mahāpāsādaṃ āropetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena[^090-9] parivisi. Bhattakiccapariyosāne sabbaṃ itthāgāraṃ āgantvā Bhagavantaṃ vandi ṭhapetvā Rāhulamātaraṃ. Sā pana "gaccha, ayyaputtaṃ vandāhīti" parijanena vuccamānāpi "sace mayhaṃ guṇo atthi sayam eva me santikaṃ ayyaputto āgamissati, āgataṃ eva naṃ vandissāmīti" vatvā na agamāsi. Bhagavā rājānaṃ pattam gāhāpetvā dvīhi aggasāvakehi saddhiṃ rājadhītāya sirigabbhaṃ gantvā "rājadhītā yathāruciṃ vandamānā na kiñci vattabbā" ti vatvā paññatte[^090-10] āsane nisīdi. Sā vegena gantvā[^090-11] gopphakesu gahetvā pādapiṭṭhiyaṃ sīsaṃ parivattetvā yathājjhāsayaṃ vandi. Rājā rājadhītāya Bhagavati sinehabahumānādiguṇasampattiyo kathesi: "bhante mama dhītā ‘tumhehi kāsāyāni


<!-- PTS Page 091 -->
<a id="page-091"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 091]*

nivatthānīti'; sutvā tato paṭṭhāya kāsāvavatthā jātā, tumhākaṃ ekabhattikabhāvaṃ sutvā ekabhattikā va jātā, tumhehi mahāsayanassa chaḍḍitabhāvaṃ[^091-1] ñatvā paṭṭikamañcake[^091-2] yeva nipannā, tumhākaṃ mālāgandhādīhi viratabhāvaṃ ñatvā viratamālāgandhā[^091-3] va jātā, attano ñātakesu ‘mayaṃ paṭijaggissāmā'; 'ti sāsane pesite ekañātikam pi na olokesi, evaṃ guṇasampannā me Bhagavā dhītā" ti. "Anacchariyaṃ mahārāja yaṃ idāni tayā rakkhiyamānā rājadhītā paripakke ñaṇe[^091-4] attānaṃ rakkheyya, esā pubbe anārakkhā pabbatapāde vicaramānā aparipakke ñāṇe attānaṃ rakkhīti" vatvā Candakinnarajātakaṃ kathetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. Dutiyadivase Nandassa rājākumārassa abhisekagehappavesanavivāhamaṅgalesu vattamānesu tassa gehaṃ gantvā kumāraṃ pattaṃ gāhāpetvā pabbājetukāmo maṅgalaṃ vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. Janapadakalyāṇī[^091-5] kumāraṃ gacchantaṃ disvā "tuvaṭaṃ kho ayyaputta āgaccheyyāsīti" vatvā gīvaṃ pasāretvā olokesi. So pi Bhagavantaṃ "pattaṃ gaṇhathā" 'ti vattuṃ avisahamāno vihāraṃ yeva agamāsi. Taṃ anicchamānaṃ yeva Bhagavā pabbājesi. Iti Bhagavā Kapilapuraṃ gantvā tatiyadivase Nandaṃ pabbājesi, Sattame divase Rāhulamātā kumāraṃ alaṃkaritvā Bhagavato santikaṃ pesesi: "Passa tāta etaṃ vīsatisahassasamaṇaparīvutaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ brahmarūpivaṇṇaṃ[^091-6] samaṇaṃ, ayaṃ te pitā, etassa mahantā nidhiyo ahesuṃ, ty-āssa[^091-7] nikkhamanato paṭṭhāya na passāma, gaccha naṃ dāyajjaṃ yāca: ‘ahaṃ tāta kumāro, abhisekaṃ patvā cakkavattī bhavissāmi[^091-8], dhanena me attho, dhanam me dehi, sāmiko hi putto pitu santakassā"'; 'ti. Kumāro ca Bhagavato santikaṃ gantvā pitu sinehaṃ paṭilabhitvā haṭṭhatuṭṭho "sukhā te samaṇa chāyā" ti vatvā aññam[^091-9] pi bahuṃ attano anurūpaṃ vadanto[^091-10] aṭṭhāsi. Bhagavā katabhattakicco anumodanaṃ katvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. Kumāro pi "dāyajjaṃ me samaṇa dehi, sāyajjaṃ me samaṇa dehīti" Bhagavantaṃ anubandhi. Bhagavā kumāraṃ na nivattāpesi. Parijano pi Bhagavatā saddhiṃ gacchanto nivattetuṃ nāsakkhi. Iti so Bhagavatā saddhiṃ ārāmam eva agamāsi. Tato Bhagavā cintesi: "yaṃ ayaṃ pitu santakaṃ[^091-11] dhanaṃ icchati taṃ vaṭṭānugataṃ[^091-12] savighātaṃ, hand'; assa bodhimaṇḍe paṭiladdhaṃ sattavidhaṃ ariyadhanaṃ demi, lokuttaradāyajjassa naṃ[^091-13] sāmikaṃ karomīti" āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āmantesi "tena hi


<!-- PTS Page 092 -->
<a id="page-092"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 092]*

tvaṃ Sāriputta Rāhulakumāraṃ pabbājehīti". Pabbajite pana kumāre rañño adhimattadukkhaṃ upajji. Taṃ adhivāsetuṃ asakkonto Bhagavato nivedetvā "sādhu bhante, ayyā[^092-1] mātāpitūhi ananuññā aṃ[^092-2] puttaṃ na pabbājeyyun" ti varaṃ yāci. Bhagavā tassa taṃ varaṃ datvā punadivase rājanivesane katapātarāso ekamantaṃ nisinnena raññā[^092-3] "bhante, tumhākaṃ dukkaracārikakāle ekā devatā maṃ upasaṃkamitvā ‘putto te kālakato'; ti āha, tassā vacanaṃ asaddahanto ‘na mayhaṃ putto bodhiṃ appatvā kālaṃ karotīti'; taṃ paṭikkhipin" ti vutto[^092-4] "idāni kiṃ[^092-5] saddahissatha ye tumhe pubbe pi aṭṭhikāni[^092-6] dassetvā ‘putto te mato'; ti vutte na saddahitthā" ti imissā aṭṭhuppattiyā Mahādhammapālajātakaṃ kathesi. Kathāpariyosāne rājā anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhahi. Iti Bhagavā pitaraṃ tīsu phalesu patiṭṭhāpetvā bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto puna-d-eva Rājagahaṃ gantvā Sītavane vihāsi. Tasmiṃ samaye Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcahi sakaṭasatehi bhaṇḍaṃ ādāya Rājāgahe piyasahāyassa seṭṭhino gehaṃ gantvā tattha Buddhassa Bhagavato uppannabhāvaṃ sutvā balavapaccūsasamaye devatānubhāvena vivaṭena dvārena Satthāraṃ upasaṃkamitvā dhammaṃ sutvā sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāya dutiyadivase buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa mahādānaṃ datvā Sāvatthiṃ[^092-7] āgamanatthāya Satthu paṭiññaṃ[^092-8] gahetvā antarāmagge pañcacattārīsayojanaṭṭhāne satasahassaṃ satasahassaṃ dāpetvā yojanikāya yojanikāya vihāre kāretvā[^092-9] Jetavanaṃ koṭisanthārena aṭṭhārasahiraññakoṭīhi kiṇitvā[^092-10] navakammaṃ paṭṭhapesi[^092-11]. So majjhe Dasabalassa gandhakuṭiṃ kāresi. Taṃ parivāretvā asītimahātherānaṃ[^092-12] pāṭiekkasannivesane[^092-13] āvāse ekakuḍḍakadvikuḍḍakahaṃsavaṭṭakadīghasālamaṇḍapādivasena sesasenāsanāni[^092-14] pokkharaṇiyo ca[^092-15] caṃkamanarattiṭṭhānadivāṭṭhānāni cā ti aṭṭhārasakoṭipariccāgena ramaṇīye bhūmibhāge manoramaṃ vihāraṃ kārāpetvā Dasabalassa āgamanatthāya dūtaṃ pesesi. Satthā dūtassa sāsanaṃ sutvā mahābhikkhusaṃghaparivāro Rājagahā nikkhamitvā anupubbena Sāvatthinagaraṃ pāpuṇi. Mahāsetthī[^092-16] pi kho vihāramahaṃ sajjetvā Tathāgatassa Jetavanaṃ[^092-17] pavisanadivase puttaṃ sabbālaṃkārapatimaṇḍitaṃ katvā alaṃkatapaṭiyatteh'; eva pañcahi kumārasatehi saddhiṃ pesesi. So saparivāro pañcavaṇṇavatthasamujjalāni pañcadhajasatāni gahetvā


<!-- PTS Page 093 -->
<a id="page-093"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 093]*

Dasabalassa purato ahosi. Tesaṃ pacchato Mahāsubhaddā-Cūlasubhaddā[^093-1] ti dve seṭṭhidhītaro pañcahi kumārisatehi[^093-2] saddhiṃ puṇṇaghaṭe gahetvā nikkhamiṃsu. Tesaṃ pacchato seṭṭhibhariyā sabbālaṃkārapatimanditā pañcahi mātugāmasatehi saddhiṃ puṇṇapātiyo gahetvā nikkhami. Sabbesaṃ pacchato sayaṃ mahāseṭṭhi[^093-3] ahatavatthanivattho ahatavattheh'; eva pañcahi seṭṭhisatehi saddhiṃ Bhagavantaṃ abbhuggañchi[^093-4]. Bhagavā imaṃ upāsakaparisaṃ purato katvā mahābhikkhusaṃghaparivuto attano sarīrappabhāya[^093-5] suvaṇṇarasasekapiñjarāni viya vanantarāni kurumāno anantāya Buddhalīḷhāya[^093-6] appaṭisamāya Buddhasiriyā Jetavanavihāraṃ pāvisi. Atha naṃ Anāthapiṇḍiko pucchi: "kath' āham bhante imasmiṃ vihāre paṭipajjāmīti". "tena hi gahapati imaṃ vihāraṃ āgatānāgatassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dehīti". "Sādhu bhante" ti mahāseṭṭhi[^093-3] suvaṇṇabhiṃkāraṃ ādāya Dasabalassa hatthe udakaṃ pātetvā "imaṃ Jetavanavihāram āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa dammīti" adāsi. Sātthā vihāraṃ paṭiggahetvā anumodanaṃ karonto JaNi_294:  "Sītaṃ uṇhaṃ paṭihanti tato vāḷamigāni[^093-7] ca siriṃsape ca makase ca sisire cāpi vuṭṭhiyo. JaNi_295:  Tato vātātape ghore sañjāte[^093-8] paṭihaññati[^093-9]. Leṇattañ ca sukhatthañ ca jhāyituñ ca vipassituṃ vihāradānaṃ saṃghassa aggaṃ Buddhena vaṇṇitaṃ. JaNi_296:  Tasmā hi paṇḍito poso sampassaṃ attham attano vihāre kāraye ramme vāsay'; ettha bahussute. JaNi_297:  Tesaṃ annañ ca pānañ ca vatthasenāsanāni ca dadeyya ujubhūtesu vippasannena cetasā.


<!-- PTS Page 094 -->
<a id="page-094"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 094]*

JaNi_298:  Te tassa dhammaṃ desenti sabbadukkhāpanūdanaṃ, yaṃ yo dhammaṃ idh'; aññāya[^094-1] parinibbāti anāsavo" ti vihārānisaṃsaṃ kathesi. Anāthapiṇḍiko dutiyadivasato paṭṭhāya vihāramahaṃ ārabhi. Visākhāya pāsādamaho catuhi[^094-3] māsehi niṭṭhito. Anāthapiṇḍikassa pana vihāramaho navahi māsehi niṭṭhāsi. Vihāramahe pi aṭṭhāras'; eva[^094-2] koṭiyo agamaṃsu, iti imasmiṃ yeva vihāre catupaṇṇāsakoṭisaṃkhaṃ dhanaṃ pariccaji. Atīte pana Vipassissa Bhagavato kāle Punabbasumitto nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇiṭṭhikasanthārena kiṇitvā[^094-4] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne yojanappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. Sikhissa Bhagavato kāle Sirivaḍḍho nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇaphālasanthārena[^094-3] kiṇitvā[^094-6] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne tigāvutappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. Vessabhussa Bhagavato kāle Sotthiyo nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇahatthipaḍasanthārena kiṇitvā[^094-4] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne aḍḍhayojanappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. kakusandhassa Bhagavato kāle Accuto nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇiṭṭhikasanthāren'; eva[^094-7] kiṇitvā[^094-8] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne gāvutappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. Koṇāgamanassa Bhagavato kāle Uggo nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇakacchapasanthārena[^094-5] kiṇitvā[^094-4] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne aḍḍhagāvutappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. kassapassa Bhagavato kāle Sumaṅgalo[^094-9] nāma seṭṭhi[^094-3] suvaṇṇiṭṭhikasanthārena kiṇitvā tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne soḷasakarīsappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. Amhākaṃ Bhagavato kāle Anāthapiṇḍiko seṭṭhi[^094-3] kahāpaṇakoṭisanthārena[^094-10] kiṇitvā[^094-8] tasmiṃ yeva ṭhāne aṭṭhakarīsappamāṇaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ kāresi. Idaṃ kira ṭhānaṃ sabbabuddhānaṃ avijahitaṭṭhānam[^094-11] eva. Iti mahābodhimaṇḍe sabbaññūtappattito[^094-12] yāva mahāparinibbānamañcā yasmiṃ ṭhāne Bhagavā vihāsi idaṃ Santikenidānaṃ nāma, tassa vasena sabbajātakāni vaṇṇayissāma. NIDĀNAKATHĀ niṭṭhitā.

##### *[PTS Page 095]*

<p align="center">NAMO TASSA</p>


BHAGAVATO ARAHATO SAMMĀSAMBUDDHASSA[^095-1]. I. EKANIPĀTA.

1. APAṆṆAKAVAGGA.

1. Apaṇṇakajātaka. Imaṃ tāva Apaṇṇakadhammadesanaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiṃ[^095-2] upanissāya Jetavanamahāvihāre viharanto kathesi. Kam pana ārabbha ayaṃ kathā samuṭṭhitā ti. Seṭṭhissa sahāyake pañcasate titthiyasāvake[^095-3]. Ekasmiṃ hi divase Anāthapiṇḍiko seṭṭhi[^095-4] attano sahāyake pañcasate aññatitthiyasāvake[^095-5] ādāya bahumālāgandhavilepanañ[^095-6] c'; eva telamadhuphāṇitavatthacchādanāni[^095-7] ca gāhāpetvā[^095-8] Jetavanaṃ gantvā Bhagavantaṃ vanditvā mālādīhi[^095-9] pūjetvā bhesajjāni c'; eva vatthāni ca bhikkhusaṃghassa vissajjetvā cha nisajjadose vajjetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Te pi aññatitthiyasāvakā[^095-10] Tathāgataṃ vanditvā Satthu puṇṇacandasassirīkaṃ mukhaṃ lakkhaṇānubyañjanapatimaṇḍitaṃ vyāmappabhāparikkhittaṃ[^095-11] brahmakāyaṃ āveḷāveḷā[^095-12] yamakayamakā[^095-13] hutvā niccharantiyo[^095-14] ghanabuddharasamiyo ca[^095-15] olokayamānā Anāthapiṇḍikassa samīpe yeva nisīdiṃsu. Atha tesaṃ[^095-16] Manosilātale sīhanādaṃ nadanto taruṇasīho viya gajjanto pāvussakamegho viya ca Ākāsagaṅgaṃ[^095-17] otā-


<!-- PTS Page 096 -->
<a id="page-096"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 096]*

rento viya[^096-1] ratanadāmaṃ ganthento viya ca aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatena savaṇīyena[^096-2] kamanīyena brahmassarena nānānayavicittaṃ madhuradhammakathaṃ[^096-3] kathesi. Te Satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pasannacittā vuṭṭhāya[^096-4] Dasabalaṃ vanditvā aññatitthiyasaraṇaṃ[^096-5] bhinditvā Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ agamaṃsu. Te tato paṭṭhāya niccakālaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikena saddhiṃ gandhamālādihatthā vihāraṃ gantvā dhammaṃ suṇanti dānaṃ denti sīlaṃ rakkhanti uposathakammaṃ karonti. Atha Bhagavā Sāvatthito puna-d-eva Rājagahaṃ agamāsi. Te Tathāgatassa gatakāle taṃ[^096-6] saraṇaṃ bhinditvā puna aññatitthiyasaraṇaṃ[^096-5] gantvā attano mūlaṭṭhāne yeva patiṭṭhitā. Bhagavāpi saṭṭaṭṭhamāse[^096-7] vītināmetvā puna Jetavanaṃ agamāsi. Anāthapiṇḍiko puna pi te ādāya Satthu santikaṃ gantvā Satthāraṃ gandhādīhi[^096-8] pūjetvā vanditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Te pi Bhagavantaṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Atha nesaṃ Tathāgate cārikaṃ pakkante gahitasaraṇaṃ bhinditvā puna aññatitthiyasaraṇam eva gahetvā mūle patiṭṭhitabhāvaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi. Bhagavā aparimitakappakoṭiyo[^096-9] nirantaraṃ pavattitavacīsucaritānubhāvena dibbagandhagandhitaṃ[^096-10] nānāgandhapūritaṃ ratanakaraṇḍakaṃ vivarento viya mukhapadumaṃ vivaritvā madhurassaraṃ[^096-11] nicchārento "saccaṃ kira tumhe upāsakā tīṇi[^096-12] saraṇāni bhinditvā aññatitthiyasaraṇaṃ[^096-5] gatā" 'ti pucchi. Atha tehi paṭicchādetuṃ asakkontehi "saccaṃ Bhagavā" 'ti vutte Satthā "upāsakā, heṭṭhā avīciṃ upari bhavaggaṃ paricchedaṃ katvā tiriyaṃ aparimāṇāsu lokadhātūsu[^096-13] sīlādiguṇena Buddhena sadiso nāma n'; atthi, kuto adhikataro, ‘yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apadā vā --pe--[^096-14] Tathāgato tesaṃ aggam akkhāyati', ‘yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā --pe--[^096-15]', ‘aggato ve pasannānan[^096-16] ti ādīhi suttehi pakāsite ratanattayaguṇe pakāsetvā[^096-17] evaṃ uttamaguṇehi[^096-18] samannāgataṃ ratanattayasaraṇaṃ[^096-19] gatā upāsakā vā upāsikā vā nirayādīsu[^096-20] nibbattanakā nāma n'; atthi, apāyanibbattito pana muccitvā[^096-21] devaloke uppajjitvā[^096-22] mahāsampattiṃ anubhonti[^096-23], tasmā tumhehi evarūpaṃ saraṇaṃ bhinditvā aññatitthiyasaraṇaṃ gacchantehi ayuttaṃ katan[^096-24]" ti āha. Ettha ca tīṇi ratanāni mokkhavasena uttamavasena saraṇagatānaṃ apāyesu nibbattiyā abhāvaṃ[^096-25] dīpanatthaṃ imāni suttāni dassetabbāni:

##### *[PTS Page 097]*

Ye keci Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā se na te gamissanti apāyaṃ[^097-1], pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ devakāyaṃ paripūressanti[^097-2]. Ye keci Dhammaṃ --pe--. Ye keci Saṃghaṃ --pe--, devakāyaṃ paripūressantīti[^097-3]. Bahuṃ ve saraṇaṃ yanti pabbatāni vanāni ca --pe--, etaṃ saraṇam āgamma sabbadukkhā pamuccatīti. (Dhpd. v. 188-192). Na kevalañ ca nesaṃ Satthā ettakaṃ yeva[^097-4] dhammaṃ desesi, api ca kho "upāsakā Buddhānussatikammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma Dhammānussati --pe-- Saṃghānussatikammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma sotāpattimaggaṃ deti sotāpattiphalaṃ deti sakadāgāmimaggaṃ deti sakadāgāmiphalam deti anāgāmimaggaṃ deti anāgāmiphalaṃ deti arahattamaggaṃ deti arahattaphalaṃ detīti" evamādīhi pi nayehi dhammaṃ desetvā "evarupaṃ nāma saraṇaṃ bhindantehi ayuttaṃ tumhehi katan" ti āha. Ettha ca Buddhānussatikammaṭṭhānādīnaṃ sotāpattimaggādippadānaṃ[^097-5] "ekadhammo bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya[^097-6] sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, katamo ekadhammo, Buddhānussatīti" evamādīhi suttehi dīpetabbaṃ. Evaṃ Bhagavā nānāppakārehi upāsake ovaditvā "upāsakā, pubbe pi manussā asaraṇaṃ saraṇan ti takkagāhena viruddhagāhena gahetvā amanussapariggahīte[^097-7] kantāre yakkhabhattaṃ hutvā mahāvināsaṃ pattā, apaṇṇakagāham[^097-8] pana ekaṃsagāhaṃ aviruddhagāhaṃ gahitamanussā tasmiṃ yeva kantāre sotthibhāvaṃ pattā" ti vatvā tuṇhī[^097-9] ahosi. Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ vanditvā abhitthavitvā sirasi[^097-10] añjalim[^097-11] patiṭṭhāpetvā evam āha: "bhante idāni tāva imesaṃ upāsakānaṃ uttamasaraṇaṃ[^097-12] bhinditvā takkagahaṇaṃ[^097-13] amhākaṃ pākaṭaṃ, pubbe pana amanussapariggahīte kantāre takkikānaṃ vināso apaṇṇakagāhaṃ gahitamanussānañ ca sotthibhāvo amhākaṃ paṭicchanno

##### *[PTS Page 098]*

tumhākam eva pākaṭo, sādhu vata no Bhagavā ākāse puṇṇacandaṃ uṭṭhāpento viya imaṃ kāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ karotū" 'ti. Atha Bhagavā "mayā kho gahapati aparimitakālaṃ dasa pāramiyo pūretvā lokassa kaṃkhacchedanattham eva sabbaññūtañāṇaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, sīhavasāya suvaṇṇanāḷiṃ[^098-1] pūrento viya sakkaccaṃ sotaṃ odahitvā suṇāhīti[^098-2]" seṭṭhino satuppādaṃ janetvā himagabbhaṃ padāletvā puṇṇacandaṃ nīharanto viya bhavantarena paṭicchannakāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi: Atīte Kāsiraṭṭhe Bārāṇasinagare[^098-3] Brahmadatto nāma rājā ahosi. Tadā Bodhisatto satthavāhakule paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā[^098-4] anupubbena vayappatto pañcahi sakaṭasatehi vaṇijjaṃ[^098-5] karonto vicarati. So kadāci pubbantato aparantaṃ gacchati kadāci aparantato pubbantaṃ. Bārāṇasiyaṃ yeva añño[^098-6] pi satthavāhaputto atthi bālo avyatto anupāyakusalo. Tadā Bodhisatto Bārāṇasito mahagghaṃ[^098-7] bhaṇḍaṃ gahetvā pañca sakaṭasatāni pūretvā gamanasajjāni katvā thāpesi. So pi bālasatthavāhaputto tath'; eva pañca sakaṭasatāni pūretvā gamanasajjāni katvā ṭhapesi. Bodhisatto cintesi: "sace ayaṃ bālasatthavāhaputto mayā saddhiṃ yeva gamissati sakaṭasahasse[^098-8] ca[^098-9] ekato magge[^098-10] gacchante maggo pi na-ppahessati[^098-11], manussānaṃ dārūdakādīni[^098-12] pi[^098-13] balivaddānaṃ tiṇāni pi dullabhāni bhavissanti, etena vā mayā vā purato gantuṃ vaṭṭatīti" so taṃ pakkosāpetvā etam atthaṃ ārocetvā "dvīhi[^098-14] amhehi ekato gantuṃ na sakkā[^098-15] ti, kiṃ tvaṃ purato gamissasi[^098-16] udāhu pacchato" ti āha. So cintesi: "mayi purato gacchante bahū[^098-17] ānisaṃsā[^098-18], maggena abhinnen'; eva gamissāmi, goṇā anāmaṭṭhatiṇaṃ khādissanti, manussānaṃ anāmaṭṭhaṃ[^098-19] sūpeyyapaṇṇaṃ bhavissati, pasannaṃ[^098-20] udakaṃ, yathāruciṃ agghaṃ ṭhapetvā bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇissāmīti[^098-21]" so "ahaṃ samma purato gamis-

sāmīti[^099-1]". Bodhisatto pi pacchato gamane bahū ānisaṃse addasa, evaṃ[^099-2] hi[^099-3] assa ahosi: "purato[^099-4] gacchantā[^099-5] magge visamaṭṭhānaṃ samaṃ karissanti, ahaṃ tehi gatamaggena gamissāmi, purato gatehi balivaddehi pariṇatathaddhatiṇe[^099-6] khādite mama goṇā puna uṭṭhitāni[^099-7] madhuratiṇāni[^099-8] khādissanti[^099-9], gahitapaṇṇaṭṭhānato uṭṭhitaṃ manussānaṃ sūpeyyapaṇṇaṃ madhuraṃ bhavissati, anudake[^099-10] ṭhāne[^099-11] khaṇitvā ete udakaṃ uppādessanti, parehi[^099-12] katesu āvāṭesu mayaṃ udakaṃ pivissāma, agghaṭṭhapanaṃ nāma manussānaṃ jīvitā voropanasadisaṃ, ahaṃ pacchato gantvā etehi ṭhapitagghen'; eva[^099-13] bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇissāmīti", atha so ettake ānisaṃse disvā "samma tvaṃ purato gacchā[^099-14]" 'ti āha. "Sādhu sammā" 'ti bālasatthavāho sakaṭāni yojetvā nikkhanto anupubbena[^099-15] manussāvāsaṃ atikkamitvā kantāramukhaṃ pāpuṇi. Kantāraṃ[^099-16] nāma corakantāraṃ vāḷakantāraṃ[^099-17] nirudakakantāraṃ[^099-18] amanussakantāraṃ appabhakkhakantāran[^099-19] ti pañcavidhaṃ, tattha corehi adhiṭṭhito maggo corakantāraṃ nāma, sīhādīhi adhiṭṭhitamaggo vāḷakantāraṃ[^099-17] nāma, yattha nahāyituṃ vā pātuṃ[^099-20] vā udakaṃ n'; atthi idaṃ nirudakakantāraṃ[^099-18] nāma, amanussādhiṭṭhitaṃ[^099-21] amanussakantāraṃ nāma, mūlakhādanīyādivirahitaṃ[^099-22] appabhakkhakantāraṃ nāma, imasmiṃ pañcavidhe kantāre taṃ kantāraṃ nirudakakantārañ[^099-18] c'; eva amanussakantārañ ca[^099-23]. Tasmā so satthavāhaputto sakaṭesu mahantamahantacāṭiyo[^099-24] ṭhapetvā[^099-25] udakassa pūrāpetvā saṭṭhiyojanikaṃ kantāraṃ paṭipajji. Ath'; assa kantāramajjhaṃ gatakāle[^099-26] kantāre adhivatthayakkho "imehi gahitaudakaṃ chaḍḍāpetvā[^099-27] dubbale katvā sabbe va ne[^099-28] khādissāmīti" sabbasetataruṇabalivadda-

yuttaṃ[^100-1] manoramaṃ yānakaṃ māpetvā[^100-2] dhanukalāpaphalakāvudhahatthehi[^100-3] dasahi dvādasahi amanussehi parivuto uppalakumudāni piḷandhitvā[^100-4] allasīso allavattho issarapuriso viya tasmiṃ yānake nisīditvā kaddamamakkhitehi[^100-5] cakkehi paṭipathaṃ agamāsi. Parivāramanussāpi 'ssa purato ca pacchato ca gacchantā allakesā allavatthā uppalakumudamālā piḷandhitvā[^100-4] padumapuṇḍarīkakalāpe gahetvā bhisamuḷālāni[^100-6] khādantā udakabindūhi c'; eva kalalena ca paggharantena agamaṃsu. Satthavāhā ca nāma yadā dhuravāto vāyati[^100-7] tadā yānake nisīditvā upaṭṭhākaparivutā rajaṃ pariharantā purato gacchanti, yadā pacchato[^100-8] vāyati tadā ten'; eva nayena pacchato gacchanti, tadā pana dhuravāto ahosi[^100-9], tasmā so satthavāhaputto purato agamāsi. Yakkho taṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā attano yānakaṃ maggā okkametvā[^100-10] "kahaṃ gacchathā" 'ti tena saddhiṃ paṭisanthāraṃ akāsi. Satthavāho pi attano yānakaṃ maggā okkamāpetvā[^100-10] sakaṭānaṃ gamanokāsaṃ datvā ekamantaṃ ṭhito[^100-11] taṃ yakkhaṃ avoca: "bho, amhe tāva Bārāṇasito āgacchāma, tumhe pana uppalakumudāni piḷandhitvā padumapuṇḍarīkahatthā bhisamuḷālāni[^100-12] khādantā kaddamamakkhitā[^100-13] udakabindūhi paggharantehi āgacchatha, kin[^100-14] nu kho tumhehi[^100-15] āgatamagge devo vassati uppalādisañchannāni[^100-16] sarāni atthīti" pucchi. Yakkho tassa kathaṃ sutvā "samma, kiṃ nām'; etaṃ kathesi, esā nīlavanarāji paññāyati[^100-17], tato paṭṭhāya sakalaṃ araññaṃ ekodakaṃ, nibaddhaṃ[^100-18] vassati, kandarā pūrā, tasmiṃ tasmiṃ[^100-19] ṭhāne padumādisañchannāni[^100-20] sarānīti[^100-21]" vatvā paṭipāṭiyā

"Pacchato āgacchantaṃ sakaṭaṃ ativiya garukaṃ hutvā āgacchati, etasmiṃ kiṃ bhaṇḍan" ti. "Udakaṃ etthā" 'ti. "Parato tāva udakaṃ ānentehi[^101-1] vo manāpaṃ[^101-2] kataṃ, ito paṭṭhāya pana udakena kiccaṃ n'; atthi, purato bahuṃ[^101-3] udakaṃ, cāṭiyo[^101-4] bhinditvā udakaṃ chaḍḍetvā[^101-5] sukhena gacchathā" 'ti āha, evañ ca pana vatvā "tumhe gacchatha, amhākaṃ papañco hotīti" thokaṃ gantvā tesaṃ adassanaṃ patvā attano yakkhanagaram eva agamāsi. So pi kho[^101-6] bālasatthavāho attano bālatāya yakkhassa vacanaṃ gahetvā cāṭiyo bhindāpetvā pasatamattam[^101-7] pi udakaṃ anavasesetvā sabbaṃ chaḍḍhetvā[^101-8] sakaṭāni pājāpesi[^101-9]. Purato appamattakam pi udakaṃ nāhosi. Manussā pānīyam[^101-10] alabhantā kilamiṃsu. Te yāva suriyass'; atthagamanā[^101-11] gantvā sakaṭāni mocetvā parivattakena ṭhapetvā goṇe cakkesu bandhiṃsu. N'; eva goṇānaṃ udakaṃ[^101-12] ahosi na manussānaṃ yāgubhattaṃ vā[^101-13]. Dubbalamanussā tattha tattha nipajjitvā sayiṃsu. Rattibhāgasamanantare yakkhā yakkhanagarato āgantvā sabbe pi goṇe ca manusse ca jīvitakkhayaṃ {pāpetvā} maṃsaṃ khāditvā aṭṭhīni avasesetvā agamaṃsu[^101-14]. Evaṃ ekaṃ bālasatthavāhaputtaṃ nissāya sabbe te vināsaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu, hatthaṭṭhikādīni[^101-15] disāvidisāvippakiṇṇāni[^101-16] ahesuṃ, pañca sakaṭasatāni yathāpūritān'; eva aṭṭhaṃsu. Bodhisatto pi kho bālasatthavāhaputtassa nikkhantadivasato māsaddhamāsaṃ vītināmetvā pañcahi sakaṭasatehi nagarā nikkhamma anupubbena kantāramukhaṃ pāpuṇi. So tattha udakacāṭiyo pūretvā bahuṃ udakaṃ ādāya khandhāvāre bheriñ[^101-17] carāpetvā manusse sanni-

Bodhisatto tesaṃ vacanaṃ[^102-12] sutvā sakaṭāni ṭhapāpetvā sabbamanusse[^102-13] sannipātāpetvā "tumhehi ‘imasmiṃ kantāre saro vā pokkharaṇī[^102-14] vā atthīti'; kassaci sutapubban" ti pucchi. ##### *[PTS Page 104]*

Satthā imaṃ kathaṃ kathetvā "evaṃ gahapati pubbe takkagāhagāhino mahāvināsaṃ pattā, apaṇṇakagāhino[^104-1] pana amanussānaṃ hatthato muñcitvā sotthinā icchitaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā puna sakaṭṭhānam eva paccāgamiṃsū[^104-2]" 'ti dve pi vatthūni ghaṭetvā imissā[^104-3] apaṇṇakadhammadesanāya[^104-4] abhisambuddho hutvā imaṃ gātham āha:

Ja_I,1.1(=1).1: Apaṇṇakaṃ ṭhānam eke dutiyaṃ āhu takkikā, etad aññāya medhāvī taṃ gaṇhe yad apaṇṇakan ti[^104-5]. ||  
Ja_I:1 ||  

Tattha apaṇṇakan ti ekaṃsikaṃ aviruddhaṃ niyyānikaṃ, ṭhānan ti kāraṇaṃ, kāraṇaṃ hi yasmā tadāyattavuttitāya phalaṃ tiṭṭhati nāma tasmā ṭhānan ti vuccati, "ṭhānañ ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ ca aṭṭhānato" ti ādisu c'; assa payogo veditabbo, iti apaṇṇakaṃ ṭhānan[^104-6] ti padadvayenāpi[^104-7] ekantahitasukhāvahattā[^104-8] paṇḍitehi paṭipannaṃ ekaṃsikakāraṇaṃ aviruddhakāraṇaṃ niyyānikakāraṇaṃ[^104-9] idan ti dīpeti, ayam ettha saṃkhepo, pabhedato pana tīṇi saraṇāgamanāni pañca sīlāni dasa sīlāni pātimokkhasaṃvaro indriyasaṃvaro ājīvapārisuddhi paccayapaṭisevanaṃ sabbam[^104-10] pi catupārisuddhisīlaṃ indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññūtā[^104-11] jāgariyānuyogo jhānaṃ[^104-12] vipassanā abhiññā samāpatti ariyamaggo ariyaphalaṃ sabbam p'; etaṃ apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ apaṇṇakapaṭipadā niyyānikapaṭipadā[^104-13] ti attho, yasmā ca pana niyyānikapaṭipadāya etaṃ nāmaṃ tasmā yeva Bhagavā apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ desento[^104-14] imaṃ suttam āha: "Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti, yoniso[^104-15] c'; assa āraddho hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya, katamehi tīhi: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu[^104-16] indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū[^104-17] hoti, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti, kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī[^104-18] hoti --pe-- evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū[^104-19] hoti: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṃkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhareti[^104-20] n'; eva davāya na madāya --pe-- evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū[^104-21] hoti, kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu[^104-22] jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu divasaṃ caṃkamena nisajjāya --pe-- evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hotīti", imasmiñ[^104-23] cāpi sutte tayo va dhammā vuttā, ayaṃ pana apaṇṇakapaṭipadā yāva arahattaphalaṃ labbhat'[^104-20]


<!-- PTS Page 105 -->
<a id="page-105"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 105]*

eva, tattha arahattaphalam[^105-1] pi phalasamāpattivihārassa c'; eva anupādāparinibbānassa ca paṭipadāy'; eva nāmaṃ[^105-2] hoti, eke ti ekacce paṇḍitamanussā, tattha kiñc'; āpi asukā nāmā 'ti niyamo n'; atthi, idaṃ pana saparisaṃ[^105-3] Bodhisattaṃ yeva sandhāya vuttan ti veditabbaṃ; dutiyaṃ āhu takkikā ti, dutiyan ti paṭhamato apaṇṇakaṭṭhānato niyyānikakāraṇato[^105-4] dutiyaṃ takkagāhakāraṇaṃ[^105-5] aniyyānikakāraṇaṃ[^105-6], āhu takkikā ti ettha pana saddhiṃ purimapadena ayaṃ yojanā: apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ aviruddhakāraṇaṃ[^105-7] niyyānikakāraṇaṃ eke[^105-8] bodhisattapamukhā paṇḍitamanussā gaṇhiṃsu, ye pana bālasatthavāhaputtapamukhā[^105-9] takkikā āhu te dutiyaṃ sāparādhaṃ anekaṃsikaṭṭhānaṃ aniyyānikakāranaṃ[^105-10] aggahesuṃ, tesu ye apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ aggahesuṃ te sukkapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā[^105-11], ye dutiyaṃ "purato bhavitabbaṃ udakenā" 'ti takkagāhasaṃkhātaṃ aniyyānikakāraṇaṃ aggahesum te kaṇhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā, tattha sukkapaṭipadā aparihānipaṭipadā kaṇhapaṭipadā parihānipaṭipadā, tasmā ye sukkapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā te aparihīnā sotthibhāvaṃ pattā ye pana kaṇhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā te parihīnā anayavyasanaṃ āpannā ti; imam atthaṃ Bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatino vatvā[^105-12] uttariṃ idam āha: Etad aññāya[^105-13] medhāvī taṃ gaṇhe yad apaṇṇakan[^105-14] ti, tattha etad aññāya[^105-13] {medhāvīti} medhā ti[^105-15] laddhanāmāya visuddhāya uttamāya paññāya[^105-16] samannāgato kulaputto, etaṃ[^105-17] apaṇṇakañ c'; eva apaṇṇake cā[^105-18] 'ti dvīsu atakkagāhatakkagāhasaṃkhātesu ṭhānesu guṇadosaṃ vuddhihāniṃ atthānatthaṃ ñatvā ti attho, taṃ gaṇhe yad apaṇṇakan[^105-19] ti yaṃ apaṇṇakaṃ ekaṃsikasukkapaṭipaḍāaparihāniyapaṭipadāsaṃkhātaṃ niyyānikakāraṇaṃ tad eva gaṇheyya, kasmā: ekaṃsikādibhāvato yeva, itaraṃ pana[^105-20] na gaṇheyya, kasmā: anekaṃsikādibhāvato yeva, ayaṃ hi[^105-21] apaṇṇakapaṭipadā nāma sabbesaṃ[^105-22] Buddhapaccekabuddhabuddhaputtānaṃ paṭipadā, sabbabuddhā hi apaṇṇakapaṭipadāyam eva[^105-23] ṭhatvā daḷhena viriyena pāramiyo pūretvā bodhitale Buddhā nāma honti, Paccekabuddhā paccekabodhiṃ uppādenti, Buddhaputtā sāvakapāramiñāṇaṃ[^105-24] paṭivijjhanti. Iti Bhagavā tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ "tisso kusalasampattiyo[^105-25] cha kāmasagge Brahmalokasampattiyo ca datvāpi[^105-26] pariyosāne arahatta-

##### *[PTS Page 106]*

maggadāyikā apaṇṇakapaṭipadā nāma catusu[^106-1] apāyesu[^106-2] pañcasu ca[^106-3] nīcakulesu nibbattidāyikā sapaṇṇakapaṭipaḍā[^106-4] nāmā" 'ti imaṃ apaṇṇakadhammadesanaṃ dassetvā upari cattāri saccāni soḷasahi ākārehi pakāsesi. Saccapariyosāne sabbe pi te pañcasatā upāsakā sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahiṃsu. Satthā imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ āharitvā[^106-5] dassetvā dve vatthūni kathetvā anusandhiṃ ghaṭetvā jātakaṃ samodhānetvā dassesi: "Tasmiṃ samaye bālasatthavāhaputto Devadatto ahosi, tassa parisā Devadattaparisā va[^106-6], paṇḍitasatthavāhaputtaparisā Buddhaparisā, paṇḍitasatthavāhaputto pana aham eva ahosin" ti desanaṃ niṭṭhapesi. Apaṇṇakajātakaṃ

2. Vaṇṇupathajātaka. Akilāsuno ti. Imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharanto kathesi. Kaṃ ārabbhā 'ti. Ekaṃ ossaṭṭhaviriyaṃ bhikkhuṃ. Tathāgate kira Sāvatthiyaṃ viharante eko sāvatthivāsī[^106-7] kulaputto Jetavanaṃ gantvā Satthu santike dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pasannacitto kāmesu ādīnavaṃ[^106-8] disvā pabbajitvā upasampadāya pañcavassiko hutvā dve mātikā uggaṇhitvā vipassanācāraṃ sikkhitvā Satthu santike attano cittaruciyaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā ekaṃ araññaṃ[^106-9] pavisitvā vassaṃ upagantvā temāsaṃ vāyamanto obhāsamattaṃ vā nimittamattaṃ vā uppādetuṃ nāsakkhi. Ath'; assa etad ahosi: "Satthārā cattāro puggalā kathitā, tesu mayā padaparamena bhavitabbaṃ, n'; atthi maññe[^106-10] mayhaṃ imasmiṃ attabhāve maggo[^106-11] vā phalaṃ vā, kiṃ karissāmi araññavāsena[^106-12], Satthu santikaṃ[^106-13] gantvā rūpaggappattaṃ Buddhasarīraṃ olokento madhuradhammadesanaṃ suṇanto viharissāmīti" puna Jetavanam eva paccāgamāsi. Atha naṃ sandiṭṭhā sambhattā āhaṃsu: "āvuso, tvaṃ Satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā ‘samaṇadhammaṃ karissāmīti'; gato, idāni pana āgantvā saṃgaṇikāya abhiramamāno carasi, kin nu kho te pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pattaṃ, appaṭisandhiko jāto sīti. "Avuso ahaṃ maggaṃ vā phalaṃ vā alabhitvā ‘abhabbapuggalena mayā bhavitabban'; ti viriyaṃ ossajitvā āgato 'mhīti". "Akāraṇaṃ[^106-14] te āvuso kataṃ daḷhaviriyassa Satthu sāsane pabbajitvā viriyaṃ ossajantena, ehi Tathāga-


<!-- PTS Page 107 -->
<a id="page-107"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 107]*

tassa taṃ dassāmā" 'ti taṃ ādāya Satthu santikaṃ agamaṃsu. Satthā disvā evam āha: "bhikkhave, tumhe etaṃ bhikkhuṃ anicchamānaṃ ādāya āgatā, kiṃ kataṃ iminā" ti. "Bhante ayaṃ bhikkhu evarūpe niyyānikasāsane pabbajitvā samaṇadhammaṃ karonto viriyaṃ ossajitvā āgato" ti. Atha naṃ Satthā āha: "saccaṃ kira tayā bhikkhu viriyaṃ ossaṭṭhaṃ". "Saccaṃ Bhagavā" ti. "Kiṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evarūpe sāsane pabbajitvā appiccho ti vā santuṭṭho ti vā pavivitto ti vā āraddhaviriyo ti vā[^107-1] evaṃ attānaṃ ajānāpetvā ossaṭṭhaviriyo bhikkhū ti jānāpesi, nanu tvaṃ pubbe viriyavā ahosi, tayā ekena kataviriyaṃ nissāya marukantāre[^107-2] pañcasu sakaṭasatesu manussā ca goṇā ca pānīyaṃ[^107-3] labhitvā sukhitā jātā, idāni kasmā viriyaṃ ossajasīti". So bhikkhu ettakena upatthambhito ahosi. Taṃ pana kathaṃ sutvā bhikkhū[^107-4] Bhagavantaṃ yāciṃsu: "bhante idāni iminā bhikkhunā viriyassa {ossaṭṭhabhāvo} amhākaṃ pākaṭo, pubbe pana etassa ekassa viriyaṃ nissāya marukantāre goṇamanussānaṃ pānīyaṃ[^107-3] labhitvā sukhitabhāvo paṭicchanno tumhākaṃ sabbaññūtañāṇass'; eva[^107-5] pākaṭo, amhākam p'; etaṃ kāraṇaṃ kathethā" 'ti. "Tena hi bhikkhave suṇāthā" 'ti Bhagavā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ satuppādaṃ janetvā bhavantarena paṭicchannakāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi: Atīte Kāsiraṭṭhe Bārāṇasiyaṃ Brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente Bodhisatto satthavāhakule paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā vayappatto pañcahi sakaṭasatehi vaṇijjaṃ karonto vicarati. So ekadā saṭṭhiyojanikaṃ marukantāraṃ paṭipajji. Tasmiṃ kantāre sukhumavālikā muṭṭhinā gahitā hatthe na tiṭṭhati, suriyuggamanato paṭṭhāya aṅgārarāsi viya uṇhā hoti, na sakkā akkamituṃ, tasmā taṃ paṭipajjantā dārūdakatelataṇḍulādīni sakaṭehi ādāya rattim eva gantvā aruṇuggamane[^107-6] sakaṭāni parivattaṃ[^107-7] katvā matthake maṇḍapaṃ kāretvā kālass'; eva[^107-8] āhārakiccaṃ niṭṭhāpetvā chāyāya nisinnā divasaṃ khepetvā atthaṃ gate suriye sāyamāsaṃ bhuñjitvā bhūmiyā sītalāya jātāya sakaṭāni yojetvā gacchanti, samuddagamanasadisam eva gamanaṃ hoti, thalaniyāmako[^107-9] nāma laddhuṃ vaṭṭati, so tāra-


<!-- PTS Page 108 -->
<a id="page-108"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 108]*

kasaññāya[^108-1] satthaṃ tāreti[^108-2]. So pi satthavāho tasmiṃ kāle iminā va niyāmena[^108-3] taṃ kantāraṃ gacchanto ekūnasaṭṭhiyojanāni gantvā "idāni ekaratten'; eva marukantārā nikkhamanaṃ bhavissatīti" sāyamāsaṃ bhuñjitvā sabbaṃ dārūdakaṃ khepetvā sakaṭāni yojetvā pāyāsi. Niyāmako[^108-4] purimasakaṭe āsandiṃ santharāpetvā ākāse tārakā[^108-5] olokento "ito pājethā[^108-6]" 'ti vadamāno nipajji. So dīgham addhānaṃ aniddāyanabhāvena kilanto niddaṃ okkami, goṇe[^108-7] nivattitvā[^108-8] āgatamaggam eva gaṇhante na aññāsi[^108-9]. Goṇā[^108-10] sabbarattiṃ agamaṃsu. Niyāmako[^108-4] aruṇuggamanavelāya[^108-11] pabuddho nakkhattaṃ oloketvā "sakaṭāni nivattetha[^108-12] nivattethā" 'ti āha. Sakaṭāni nivattetvā paṭipāṭiṃ karontānaṃ yeva aruṇo uggamano[^108-13]. Manussā "hiyyo amhākaṃ niviṭṭhakhandhāvāraṭṭhānam ev'; etaṃ, dārūdakam pi no[^108-14] khīṇaṃ[^108-15], idāni 'mhā naṭṭhā" ti sakaṭāni mocetvā parivattakena ṭhapetvā matthake maṇḍapaṃ katvā attano attano sakaṭassa heṭṭhā anusocantā nipajjiṃsu. Bodhisatto "mayi viriyaṃ ossajante[^108-16] sabbe vinassissantīti" pāto sītalavelāyam eva āhiṇḍanto ekaṃ dabbatiṇagacchaṃ disvā "imāni tiṇāni heṭṭhā udakasinehena uṭṭhitāni bhavissantīti" cintetvā kuddālaṃ gāhāpetvā[^108-17] taṃ padesaṃ khaṇāpesi. Saṭṭhihatthaṭṭhānaṃ khaṇiṃsu. Ettakaṃ ṭhānaṃ khaṇitvā paharantānaṃ kuddālo heṭṭhā pāsāṇe paṭihaññi[^108-18], pahaṭamatte sabbe viriyaṃ ossajiṃsu. Bodhisatto pana "imassa pāsāṇassa heṭṭhā udakena bhavitabban" ti otaritvā pāsāṇe ṭhito onamitvā[^108-19] sotaṃ odahitvā saddaṃ āvajjento heṭṭhā udakassa pavattanasaddaṃ sutvā uttaritvā cūlūpaṭṭhākaṃ āha: "tāta, tayā viriye ossaṭṭhe sabbe vinassissāma, tvaṃ viriyaṃ anossajitvā imaṃ ayakūṭaṃ gahetvā āvātaṃ otaritvā etasmiṃ pāsāṇe pahāraṃ dehīti[^108-20]. So tassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā


<!-- PTS Page 109 -->
<a id="page-109"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 109]*

sabbesu viriyaṃ ossajitvā ṭhitesu pi[^109-1] viriyaṃ anossajanto otaritvā pāsāṇe pahāraṃ adāsi. Pāsāṇo majjhe bhijjitvā heṭṭhā patitvā sotaṃ sannirumhitvā[^109-2] aṭṭhāsi. Tālakkhandhappamāṇā[^109-3] udakavaṭṭi[^109-4] uggañchi[^109-5]. Sabbe pānīyaṃ pivitvā nahāyiṃsu. Atirekāni akkhayugādīni phāletvā[^109-6] yāgubhattaṃ pacitvā bhuñjitvā[^109-7] goṇe ca bhojetvā suriye atthaṃ gate udakāvāṭasamīpe[^109-8] dhajaṃ[^109-9] bandhitvā icchitaṭṭhānaṃ agamiṃsu. Te tattha bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇitvā dviguṇaṃ[^109-10] catugguṇaṃ bhogaṃ labhitvā attano vasanaṭṭhānam eva agamiṃsu. Te tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yathākammaṃ gatā. Bodhisatto pi dānādīni puññāni[^109-11] katvā yathākammam eva gato. Sammāsambuddho imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathetvā abhisambuddho va imaṃ gāthaṃ kathesi:

Ja_I,1.2(=2).1: Akilāsuno vaṇṇupathe[^109-12] khaṇantā udaṅgaṇe tattha papaṃ avinduṃ, evaṃ muni[^109-13] viriyabalūpapanno akilāsu vinde hadayassa santin ti. ||  
Ja_I:2 ||  

Tattha akilāsuno ti nikkosajjā āraddhaviriyā, vaṇṇupathe ti, vaṇṇu vuccati vālukā, vālukāmagge ti attho, khaṇantā ti bhūmiṃ khaṇamānā[^109-14], udaṅgaṇe ti, ettha uda iti nipāto, aṅgaṇe ti attho, manussānaṃ saṃcaraṇaṭṭhāne anāvaṭe[^109-15] bhūmibhāge ti attho, tatthā ti tasmiṃ vaṇṇupathe, papaṃ avindun ti udakaṃ labhiṃsu, udakaṃ[^109-16] hi papīyanabhāvena[^109-17] papā ti vuccati, pavaṭṭaṃ[^109-18] vā āpaṃ papaṃ, mahodakan ti attho; evan ti opammapaṭipādanaṃ[^109-19], munīti[^109-20], monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ, kāyamoneyyādīsu[^109-21] vā aññataraṃ[^109-22], tena samannāgatattā puggalo munīti[^109-20] vuccati, so pan'; esa agāriyamuni anagāriyamuni sekhamuni asekhamuni paccekamuni munimunīti[^109-23] anekavidho, tattha agāriyamunīti gihī āgataphalo viññātasāsano[^109-24], anagāriyamunīti tathārūpo va pabbajito, sekkhamunīti sattasekhā, asekhamunīti[^109-25] khīṇāsavo, paccekamunīti paccekasambuddho, munimunīti sammāsambuddho, imasmiṃ pan'; atthe sabba-


<!-- PTS Page 110 -->
<a id="page-110"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 110]*

saṃgāhikavasena[^110-1] moneyyasaṃkhātāya paññāya[^110-2] samannāgato munīti veditabbo, viriyabalūpapanno ti viriyena c'; eva kāyabalañāṇabalena ca[^110-3] samannāgato, akilāsū ti nikkosajjo, kāmaṃ[^110-4] taco ca[^110-5] nahāru[^110-6] ca aṭṭhi[^110-7] ca avasussatu upasussatu[^110-8] sarīre maṃsalohitan ti evaṃ vuttena caturaṅgasamannāgatena viriyena samannāgatattā analaso, vinde hadayassa santin ti cittassa pi hadayarūpassa pi sītalabhāvakaraṇena santin ti saṃkhaṃ gataṃ jhānavipassanābhiññāarahattamaggañāṇasaṃkhātaṃ[^110-9] arivadhammaṃ vindati paṭilabhatīti attho. Bhagavatā hi: "dukkhaṃ bhikkhave kusīto viharati vokiṇṇo pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi mahantañ ca sadatthaṃ parihāpeti, āraddhaviriyo ca[^110-10] kho bhikkhave sukhaṃ viharati pavivitto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi mahantañ ca sadatthaṃ paripūreti[^110-11], na bhikkhave hīnena aggassa pattī[^110-12] hotīti" evaṃ anekehi suttehi kusītassa dukkhavihāro āraddhaviriyassa sukhavihāro saṃvaṇṇito, idhāpi āraddhaviriyassa akatābhinivesassa[^110-13] vipassakassa viriyabalena adhigantabbaṃ, tam eva sukhavihāraṃ dassento "evaṃ muni[^110-14] viriyabalūpapanno akilāsu vinde hadayassa santin" ti āha. Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti: "yathā te vāṇijā akilāsuno vaṇṇupathe[^110-15] khaṇantā udakaṃ labhiṃsu evaṃ imasmim pi[^110-16] sāsane akilāsu hutvā vāyamamāno paṇḍito[^110-17] bhikkhu imaṃ jhānādibhedaṃ hadayasantiṃ[^110-18] labhati, so tvaṃ bhikkhu pubbe udakamattassa atthāya viriyaṃ katvā idāni evarūpe maggaphalatthāya[^110-19] niyyānikasāsane kasmā viriyaṃ ossajasīti". Evaṃ imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ dassetvā cattāri saccāni pakāsesi. Saccapariyosāne ossaṭṭhaviriyo bhikkhu aggaphale arahatte patiṭṭhāsi. Satthā dve vatthūni kathetvā anusandhiṃ ghaṭetvā jātakaṃ samodhānetvā dassesi: "Tasmiṃ samaye viriyaṃ anossajitvā pāsāṇaṃ bhinditvā mahājanassa udakadāyako cūlūpaṭṭhāko[^110-20] ayaṃ ossaṭṭhaviriyo bhikkhu ahosi, avasesaparisā idāni Buddhaparisā jātā, satthavāhajeṭṭhako pana aham eva ahosin" ti desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi. Vaṇṇupathajātakaṃ[^110-15].

3. Serivāṇijajātaka. Idha ce hi naṃ virādhesīti. Imam[^110-21] pi dhammadesanaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharanto ekaṃ ossaṭṭhaviriyam eva bhikkhuṃ ārabbha kathesi. Taṃ hi purimanayen'; eva bhikkhūhi ānītaṃ Satthā āha: "tvaṃ bhikkhu[^110-22] evarūpe maggaphaladāyake


<!-- PTS Page 111 -->
<a id="page-111"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 111]*

sāsane pabbajitvā viriyaṃ ossajanto satasahassagghanikāya[^111-1] kañcanapātiyā parihīno Serivavāṇijo[^111-2] viya ciraṃ socissasīti. Bhikkhū tassa atthassāvibhāvatthaṃ[^111-3] Bhagavantaṃ yāciṃsu. Bhagavā bhavantarena paṭicchannaṃ kāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi: Atīte ito pañcame kappe Bodhisatto Serivaraṭṭhe Serivo nāma kacchapuṭavāṇijo[^111-4] ahosi. So Serivā nāma ekena lolakacchapuṭavāṇijena[^111-5] saddhiṃ Telavāhaṃ[^111-6] nāma nadiṃ uttaritvā Andhapuraṃ nāma nagaraṃ pavisanto nagaravīthiyo bhājetvā attano pattavīthiyā bhaṇḍaṃ vikkiṇanto[^111-7] cari. Itaro attano pattaṃ[^111-8] vīthiṃ gaṇhi. Tasmiñ ca nagare ekaṃ seṭṭhikulaṃ parijiṇṇaṃ ahosi, sabbe puttabhātikā ca dhanañ ca parikkhayaṃ agamāsi. Ekā[^111-9] dārikā ayyakāya saddhiṃ avasesā ahosi. Tā dve pi paresaṃ bhatiṃ katvā jīvanti. Gehe pana tesaṃ mahāseṭṭhinā paribhuttapubbā suvaṇṇapāti bhājanantare nikkhittā dīgharattaṃ avalañjiyamānā[^111-10] malaggahītā[^111-11] ahosi. Tā tassā suvaṇṇapātibhāvam pi na jānanti. So lolavāṇijo tasmiṃ samaye "maṇike gaṇhatha[^111-12], maṇike gaṇhathā" 'ti vicaranto gharadvāraṃ pāpuṇi. Sā kumārikā taṃ disvā ayyakaṃ āha: "amma mayhaṃ ekaṃ pilandhanaṃ[^111-13] gaṇhā" 'ti. "Amma mayaṃ duggatā, kiṃ datvā gaṇhissāmā" 'ti. "Ayaṃ no pāti atthi[^111-14] no ca amhākaṃ upakārā, imaṃ datvā gaṇhā" 'ti. Sā vānijaṃ[^111-15] pakkosāpetvā āsane {nisīdāpetvā} taṃ pātiṃ datvā "ayya imaṃ gahetvā tava bhaginiyā kiñcid eva dehīti" āha. Vāṇijo[^111-16] pātiṃ hatthena gahetvā "suvaṇṇapāti bhavissatīti" parivattetvā pātipiṭṭhiyā[^111-17] sūciyā lekhaṃ kaḍḍhitvā[^111-18] suvaṇṇabhāvaṃ ñatvā[^111-19] "imesaṃ kiñci adatvā va imaṃ pātiṃ[^111-20] harissāmīti" "ayaṃ kiṃ agghati[^111-21], addhamāsako pi 'ssā mūlaṃ


<!-- PTS Page 112 -->
<a id="page-112"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 112]*

na hotīti" bhūmiyaṃ khipitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. Tena[^112-1] pavisitvā nikkhantavīthiṃ[^112-2] itaro pavisituṃ labbhatīti Bodhisatto taṃ vīthiṃ[^112-3] pavisitvā "maṇike gaṇhathā" 'ti taṃ eva gharadvāraṃ pāpuṇi. Puna sā kumārikā tath'; eva ayyakaṃ āha. Atha naṃ ayyakā "amma, paṭhamaṃ āgatavāṇijo pātiṃ bhūmiyaṃ[^112-4] khipitvā gato, idāni kiṃ datvā gaṇhissāmā" 'ti āha. "Amma, so vāṇijo pharusavāco, ayaṃ pana piyadassano mudusallāpo, app-eva nāma naṃ gaṇheyyā" 'ti. "Tena hi pakkosā" 'ti. Sā taṃ pakkosi. Ath'; assa gehaṃ pavisitvā nisinnassa taṃ pātiṃ adaṃsu. So tassā suvaṇṇapātibhāvaṃ ñatvā "amma, ayaṃ pāti satasahassaṃ agghati, pāṭiagghanakabhaṇḍam[^112-5] mayhaṃ hatthe n'; atthīti" āha. "Ayya, paṭhamaṃ āgatavāṇijo ‘ayaṃ addhamāsakam pi na agghatīti'; bhūmiyaṃ khipitvā gato, ayaṃ pana tava puññena suvaṇṇapāti jātā bhavissatīti mayaṃ imaṃ tuyhaṃ dema, kiñcid eva no datvā imaṃ gahetvā yāhīti". Bodhisatto tasmiṃ khaṇe hatthagatāni pañca kahāpaṇasatāni[^112-6] pañcasatagghaṇakañ[^112-7] ca bhaṇḍaṃ sabbaṃ datvā "mayhaṃ imaṃ tulañ ca pasibbakañ ca aṭṭha ca kahāpaṇe[^112-8] dethā" 'ti ettakaṃ yācitvā ādāya pakkāmi. So sīgham eva nadītīraṃ gantvā nāvikassa aṭṭha kahāpaṇe[^112-9] datvā nāvaṃ abhirūhi. Tato lolavāṇijo[^112-10] pi puna gehaṃ[^112-11] gantvā "āharatha taṃ[^112-12] pātiṃ, tumhākaṃ kiñcid eva dassāmīti" āha. Sā taṃ paribhāsitvā "tvaṃ amhākaṃ satasahassagghanikaṃ[^112-13] suvaṇṇapātiṃ addhamāsakagghanikam[^112-13] pi na akāsi, tuyhaṃ pana sāmikasadiso eko dhammikavāṇijo amhākaṃ sahassaṃ datvā taṃ ādāya gato" ti āha. Taṃ sutvā "tassa satasahassagghanikāya[^112-13] hi[^112-14] suvaṇṇapātiyā parihīno 'mhi, mahājānikaro vata me ayan[^112-15]" ti sañjātabalavasoko satiṃ[^112-16] paccupaṭṭhāpetuṃ asak-


<!-- PTS Page 113 -->
<a id="page-113"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 113]*

konto visaññī[^113-1] hutvā attano hatthagate kahāpaṇe[^113-2] c'; eva bhaṇḍakañ ca gharadvāre yeva vikiritvā nivāsanapārupanam pahāya[^113-3] tulādaṇḍaṃ muggaraṃ katvā ādāya Bodhisattassa anupadaṃ pakkanto nadītīraṃ gantvā Bodhisattaṃ gacchantaṃ disvā "ambho[^113-4] nāvika[^113-5] nāvaṃ nivattehīti" āha. Bodhisatto "mā nivattayīti[^113-6]" paṭisedheti. Itarassāpi Bodhisattaṃ gacchantaṃ passantassa passantassa balavasoko udapādi. Hadayaṃ uṇhaṃ ahosi, mukhato lohitaṃ uggañchi, vāpikaddamo viya hadayaṃ phali. So Bodhisatte āghātaṃ bandhitvā tatth'; eva jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ Devadattassa Bodhisatte āghātabandhanaṃ. Bodhisatto dānādīni puññāni karitvā yathākammaṃ agamāsi. Sammāsambuddho imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathetvā abhisambuddho va imaṃ gāthaṃ kathesi:

Ja_I,1.3(=3).1: Idha ce hi naṃ virādhesi saddhammassa niyāmataṃ ciraṃ tvaṃ anutapessasi Serivāyaṃ va vāṇijo ti. ||  
Ja_I:3 ||  

Tattha idha ce hi naṃ virādhesi saddhammassa niyāmatan ti imasmiṃ sāsane etaṃ saddhammassa niyāmatāsaṃkhātaṃ[^113-7] sotāpattimaggaṃ virādhesi yadi virādhesi viriyaṃ ossajanto nādhigacchasi na paṭilabhasīti attho, ciraṃ tvaṃ anutapessasīti evaṃ sante tvaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ socanto paridevanto añutapessasi, athavā ossaṭṭhaviriyatāya ariyamaggassa virādhitattā dīgharattaṃ nirayādīsu[^113-8] uppanno nānappakārāni dukkhāni anubhavanto anutapessasi kilamissasīti[^113-9], ayam ettha attho; kathaṃ: Serivāyaṃ va vāṇijo[^113-10] ti, Serivā ti evaṃnāmako 'yam, vā 'ti yathā, idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti: yathā pubbe Serivā nāma vāṇijo satasahassagghanikaṃ[^113-11] suvaṇṇapātiṃ labhitvā tassa gahaṇatthāya[^113-12] viriyaṃ akatvā tato parihīno anutappi evam eva tvam[^113-13] pi imasmiṃ sāsane paṭiyattasuvaṇṇapātisadisaṃ ariyamaggaṃ ossaṭṭhaviriyatāya anadhigacchanto tato parihīno dīgharattaṃ anutappissasi[^113-14], sace pana viriyaṃ na ossajissasi[^113-15] paṇḍitavāṇijo suvaṇṇapātiṃ viya mama sāsane navavidham pi lokuttaradhammaṃ[^113-16] paṭilabhissasīti[^113-17].

##### *[PTS Page 114]*

Evam assa Satthā arahattena[^114-1] kūṭaṃ gaṇhanto imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ dassetvā cattāri saccāni pakāsesi. Saccapariyosāne ossaṭṭhaviriyo bhikkhu aggaphale arahatte[^114-2] patiṭṭhāsi. Satthāpi dve vatthūni kathetvā anusandhiṃ ghaṭetvā jātakaṃ samodhānetvā dassesi: "Tadā bālavāṇijo[^114-3] Devadatto ahosi, paṇḍitavāṇijo aham eva ahosin" ti desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi. Serivāṇijajātakaṃ[^114-4].

4. Cullakaseṭṭhijātaka. Appakena pi medhāvīti. Imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahaṃ upanissāya Jīvakambavane viharanto Cullapanthakattheraṃ ārabbha kathesi. Tattha[^114-5] Cullapanthakassa tāva nibbatti kathetabbā. Rājagahe kira dhanaseṭṭhikulassa dhītā attano dāsen'; eva saddhiṃ santhavaṃ katvā "aññe pi me imaṃ kammaṃ jāneyyun" ti bhītā evam āha: "amhehi imasmiṃ ṭhāne vasituṃ na sakkā, sace me mātāpitaro. imaṃ dosaṃ jānissanti khaṇḍākhaṇḍaṃ karissanti, videsaṃ gantvā vasissāmā" 'ti hatthasāraṃ gahetvā aggadvārena nikkhamitvā "yattha vā tattha vā aññehi ajānanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā vasissāmā" 'ti ubho pi agamaṃsu. Tesaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne vasantānaṃ saṃvāsam anvāya tassā kucchiyaṃ gabbho patiṭṭhāsi. Sā gabbhaparipākam āgamma sāmikena saddhiṃ mantesi: "gabbho me paripākaṃ gato, ñātibandhuvirahite ca ṭhāne gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ nāma ubhinnam pi amhākaṃ dukkham eva, kulagehaṃ gacchāmā" 'ti. So "ajja gacchāma, sve gacchāmā" 'ti[^114-6] divase[^114-7] atikkāmesi. Sā cintesi: "ayaṃ bālo attano dosamahantatāya gantuṃ na ussahati, mātāpitaro nāma ekantahitā, ayaṃ gacchatu vā mā vā mayā gantuṃ vaṭṭatīti"[^114-8]. Tasmiṃ gehā nikkhante gehaparikkhāraṃ paṭisāmetvā attano kulagharaṃ gatabhāvaṃ anantaragehavāsīnaṃ[^114-9] ārocetvā maggaṃ paṭipajji. Atha so puriso gharaṃ āgato taṃ adisvā[^114-10] paṭivissake pucchitvā "kulagharaṃ gatā" ti sutvā vegena anubandhitvā antarāmagge[^114-11] sampāpuṇi. Tassāpi tatth'; eva gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ ahosi. So "kiṃ idaṃ bhadde" ti pucchi. "Sāmi, eko putto jāto" ti. "Idāni kiṃ karissāmā" 'ti. "Yass'; atthāya mayaṃ kulagharaṃ gaccheyyāma taṃ kammaṃ antarā va nipphannaṃ[^114-12], tattha gantvā kiṃ karissāma, nivattāmā" 'ti dve pi ekacittā hutvā nivattiṃsu. Tassa ca dārakassa panthe jātattā Panthako ti nāmaṃ


<!-- PTS Page 115 -->
<a id="page-115"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 115]*

akaṃsu. Tassā na cirass'; eva aparo pi gabbho patiṭṭhahi. Sabbaṃ purimanayen'; eva vitthāretabbaṃ. Tassa pi dārakassa panthe jātattā paṭhamajātassa Mahāpanthako ti nāmaṃ katvā itarassa Cullapanthako ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. Te dve pi dārake gahetvā attano vasanaṭṭhānam eva āgatā. Tesaṃ tattha vasantānaṃ ayaṃ Panthadārako aññe[^115-1] dārake[^115-2] cullapitā ti ayyako ti ayyakā ti[^115-3] vadante[^115-4] sutvā mātaraṃ pucchi: "amma aññe[^115-1] dārakā cullapitā ti ayyako ti ayyakā ti[^115-5] vadanti, amhākaṃ ñātakā n'; atthīti". "Āma tāta, tumhākaṃ ettha ñātakā n'; atthi, Rājagahanagare pana[^115-6] vo dhanaseṭṭhi[^115-7] nāma ayyako, tattha tumhākaṃ bahuñātakā" ti. "Kasmā tattha na gacchāma ammā" ti. Sā attano agamanakāraṇaṃ[^115-8] puttassa kathetvā puttesu punappuna kathentesu sāmikaṃ āha: "ime dārakā ativiya kilamenti, kiṃ no mātāpitaro disvā maṃsaṃ khādissanti, ehi dārakānaṃ ayyakakulaṃ dassemā" 'ti. "Ahaṃ sammukhā va ṭhātuṃ na sakkhissāmi, taṃ pana tattha nayissāmīti[^115-9]". "Sādhu ayya, yena kenaci nayena dārakānaṃ ayyakakulam[^115-10] eva daṭṭhuṃ vaṭṭatīti[^115-11]". Dve pi janā dārake ādāya anupubbena Rājagahaṃ[^115-12] patvā nagaradvāre[^115-13] ekissā sālāya nivāsaṃ kappetvā dārakamātā dve dārake gahetvā[^115-14] āgatabhāvaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ ārocāpesi. Te taṃ sāsanaṃ sutvā "saṃsāre carantānaṃ na putto dhītā[^115-15] nāma n'; atthi, te amhākaṃ mahāparādhikā, na sakkā tehi amhākaṃ cakkhupathe ṭhātuṃ, ettakaṃ pana nāma dhanaṃ gahetvā dve pi janā phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā jīvantu, dārake[^115-16] pana idha pesentū" ti. Seṭṭhidhītā mātāpitūhi[^115-17] pesitaṃ dhanaṃ gahetvā dārake āgatadūtānaṃ yeva hatthe datvā pesesi. Dārakā ayyakakule vaḍḍhanti. Tesu Cullapanthako atidaharo, Mahāpanthako pana ayyakena saddhiṃ Dasabalassa dhammakathaṃ sotuṃ gacchati. Tassa niccaṃ Satthu sammukhā dhammaṃ suṇantassa pabbajjāya cittaṃ nami. So ayyakaṃ āha: "sace tumhe sampaṭicchatha ahaṃ pabbajeyyan" ti. "Kiṃ vadesi tāta, mayhaṃ sakalalokassāpi pabbajato tav'; eva[^115-18] pabbajjā bhaddikā, sace sakkosi pabbaja tātā" 'ti sampaṭicchitvā Satthu santikaṃ gato. Satthā "kiṃ mahāseṭṭhi dārako te laddho" ti. "Āma bhante, ayaṃ dārako mayhaṃ nattā[^115-19]


<!-- PTS Page 116 -->
<a id="page-116"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 116]*

‘tumhākaṃ santike pabbajāmīti[^116-1] āha". Satthā aññataraṃ[^116-2] piṇḍacārikaṃ "imaṃ dārakaṃ pabbājehīti" āṇāpesi[^116-3]. Thero tassa tacapañcakakammaṭṭhānaṃ ācikkhitvā pabbājesi. So bahuṃ Buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhitvā paripuṇṇavasso upasampadaṃ labhi, upasampanno yonisomanasikāre kammaṃ karonto arahattam[^116-4] pāpuṇi[^116-5]. So jhānasukhena maggasukhena ca vītināmento cintesi: "sakkā nu kho imaṃ sukhaṃ Cullapanthakassa dātun" ti. Tato ayyakaseṭṭhissa santikaṃ gantvā "mahāseṭṭhi sace tumhe sampaṭicchatha ahaṃ Cullapanthakaṃ pabbājeyyan" ti āha. "Pabbājetha bhante" ti. Thero Cullapanthakadārakaṃ pabbājetvā dasasu sīlesu patiṭṭhāpesi. Cullapanthakasāmaṇero pabbajitvā va dandho ahosi. Padumaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ pāto siyā phullam avītagandhaṃ Aṅgīrasam passa[^116-6] virocamānaṃ tapantam ādiccam iv'; antalikkhe ti imaṃ ekaṃ gātham catuhi[^116-7] māsehi gaṇhituṃ nāsakkhi. So kira Kassapasammāsambuddhakāle pabbajitvā paññavā[^116-8] hutvā aññatarassa[^116-2] dandhabhikkhuno uddesagahaṇakāle parihāsakeḷiṃ[^116-9] akāsi. So bhikkhu tena parihāsena[^116-10] lajjito n'; eva uddesaṃ gaṇhi na sajjhāyam akāsi. Tena kammenāyaṃ pabbajitvā va[^116-11] dandho jāto, gahitagahitaṃ padaṃ upari upari gaṇhantassa nassati, tassa imam eva gāthaṃ gahetuṃ vāyamantassa cattāro māsā atikkantā. Atha naṃ Mahāpanthako āha: "Panthaka, tvaṃ imasmiṃ sāsane abhabbo, catuhi[^116-7] māsehi ekaṃ gātham pi gahetuṃ na sakkosi[^116-12], pabbajitakiccaṃ pana tvaṃ kathaṃ matthakaṃ pāpessasi, nikkhama ito vihārā" ti nikkaḍḍhi. Cullapanthako Buddhasāsane sinehena gihibhāvaṃ[^116-13] na pattheti. Tasmiñ ca kāle Mahāpanthako bhattuddesako hoti. Jīvako Komārabhacco[^116-14] bahuṃ gandhamālaṃ ādāya attano ambavanaṃ gantvā Satthāraṃ pūjetvā dhammaṃ sutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Dasabalaṃ vanditvā Mahāpanthakaṃ upasaṃkamitvā "kittakā bhante Satthu santike bhikkhū" ti pucchi. "Pañcamattāni satānīti." "Sve bhante buddhapamukhāni pañca bhikkhusatāni ādāya amhākaṃ nivesane bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā" 'ti. "Upāsaka, Cullapanthako nāma dandho avirūḷhidhammo[^116-15], taṃ ṭhapetvā sesānaṃ nimantaṇaṃ[^116-16]


<!-- PTS Page 117 -->
<a id="page-117"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 117]*

paṭicchāmīti" thero āha. Taṃ sutvā Cullapanthako cintesi: "thero ettakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ nimantaṇaṃ paṭicchanto maṃ bāhiraṃ katvā paṭicchati, nissaṃsayaṃ mayhaṃ bhātikassa mayi cittaṃ[^117-1] bhinnaṃ bhavissati, kiṃ dāni mayhaṃ iminā sāsanena, gihī hutvā dānādīni puññāni[^117-2] karonto jīvissāmīti" so punadivase pāto va "gihī bhavissāmīti" pāyāsi. Satthā paccūsakāle yeva lokaṃ olokento imaṃ kāraṇaṃ disvā paṭhamataraṃ gantvā Cullapanthakassa gamanamagge dvārakoṭṭhake caṃkamanto aṭṭhāsi. Cullapanthako gharā nikkhamanto Satthāraṃ disvā upasaṃkamitvā vandi. Atha naṃ Satthā "kahaṃ pana tvaṃ Cullapanthaka imāya velāya gacchasīti" āha. "Bhātā maṃ bhante nikkaḍḍhati, tenāhaṃ vibbhamituṃ gacchamīti. "Cullapanthaka, tava pabbajjā nāma mama santakā, bhātarā nikkaḍḍhito kasmā mama santikaṃ nāgañchi, ehi kin te gihibhāvena[^117-3], mama santike bhavissasīti" Cullapanthakaṃ ādāya gantvā gandhakuṭipamukhe nisīdāpetvā "Cullapanthaka puratthābhimukho hutvā imaṃ pilotikaṃ rajoharaṇaṃ rajoharaṇan ti parimajjanto idh'; eva hohīti" iddhiyā abhisaṃkhaṭaṃ parisuddhaṃ pilotikaṃ datvā kāle ārocite bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto Jīvakassa gehaṃ gantvā paññattāsane[^117-4] nisīdi. Cullapanthako[^117-5] pi suriyaṃ olokento taṃ[^117-6] pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ rajoharaṇaṃ rajoharaṇan ti parimajjanto nisīdi. Tassa taṃ pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ parimajjantassa parimajjantassa kiliṭṭhaṃ ahosi. Tato cintesi: "idaṃ pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ ativiya[^117-7] parisuddhaṃ, imaṃ pana attabhāvaṃ nissāya purimapakatiṃ vijahitvā evaṃ kiliṭṭhaṃ jātaṃ, aniccā vata saṃkhārā ti khayavayaṃ paṭṭhapento vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhesi. Satthā Cullapanthakassa[^117-5] cittaṃ vipassanaṃ[^117-8] ārūḷhan ti ñatvā "Cullapanthaka[^117-5], tvaṃ ‘etaṃ pilotikakhaṇḍam eva saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ rajarañjitaṃ[^117-9] jātan'; ti mā saññaṃ kari, abbhantare pana[^117-10] te rāgarajādayo atthi, te harāhīti vatvā obhāsaṃ vissajjetvā purato nisinno viya paññāyamānarūpo[^117-11] hutvā imā gāthā abhāsi: Rāgo rajo na ca pana reṇu[^117-12] vuccati, rāgass'; etaṃ adhivacanaṃ rajo ti; etaṃ rajaṃ vippajahitvā bhikkhavo viharanti te vigatarajassa sāsane.


<!-- PTS Page 118 -->
<a id="page-118"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 118]*

Doso rajo --pe--. Moho rajo na ca pana reṇu[^118-1] vuccati, mohass'; etaṃ adhivacanaṃ rajo ti; etaṃ rajaṃ vippajahitvā bhikkhavo viharanti te vigatarajassa sāsane ti. Gāthāpariyosāne Cullapanthako[^118-2] saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattam[^118-3] pāpuṇi[^118-4], Paṭisambhidāhi yev'; assa tīṇi[^118-5] Piṭakāni āgamiṃsu[^118-6]. So kira pubbe rājā hutvā nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karonto[^118-7] nalāṭato sede muñcante[^118-8] parisuddhena sāṭakena nalāṭantaṃ puñji[^118-9]. Sāṭako kiliṭṭho ahosi. So "imaṃ sarīraṃ nissāya evarūpo parisuddho sāṭako pakatiṃ jahitvā kiliṭṭho jāto, aniccā vata saṃkhāra" ti aniccasaññaṃ[^118-10] paṭilabhi, tena kāraṇen'; assa rajoharaṇam eva paccayo jāto. Jīvako pi kho[^118-11] Komārabhacco[^118-12] Dasabalassa dakkhiṇodakaṃ upanāmesi. Satthā "nanu Jīvaka vihāre bhikkhū[^118-13] atthīti" hatthena pattaṃ pidahi. Mahāpanthako "nanu bhante vihāre n'; atthi bhikkhū ti[^118-14]" āha. Satthā "atthi Jīvakā" 'ti āha. Jīvako "tena hi bhaṇe[^118-15] gaccha[^118-16], vihāre bhikkhūnaṃ atthibhāvaṃ vā natthibhāvaṃ vā jānāhīti" purisaṃ pesesi. Tasmiṃ khaṇe Cullapanthako[^118-2] "mayhaṃ bhātiko ‘vihāre bhikkhū n'; atthīti'; bhaṇati, vihāre[^118-17] bhikkhūnaṃ atthibhāvam assa pakāsessāmīti" sakalaṃ ambavanaṃ bhikkhūnañ ñeva[^118-18] pūresi. Ekacce bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karonti, ekacce rajanakammaṃ[^118-19], ekacce sajjhāyaṃ karontīti evaṃ aññamaññaṃ[^118-20] asadisaṃ bhikkhusahassaṃ māpesi. So puriso vihāre bahū bhikkhū disvā nivattivā "ayya sakalaṃ ambavanaṃ bhikkhūhi paripuṇṇan" ti Jīvakassa ārocesi. Thero pi kho tatth'; eva[^118-21] "Sahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ nimminitvāna Panthako nisīdi ambavane ramme yāva kālappavedanā" ti. Atha Satthā taṃ purisaṃ āha: "vihāraṃ gantvā ‘Satthā Cullapanthakaṃ[^118-22] nāma pakkosatīti'; vadehīti". Tena gantvā tathā vutte "ahaṃ Cullapanthako[^118-22] ahaṃ Cullapanthako[^118-23]" ti mukhasahassaṃ uṭṭhahi. Puriso gantvā "sabbe pi kira bhante Cullapanthakā[^118-23] yeva nāmā" 'ti āha. "Tena hi tvaṃ gantvā yo ‘ahaṃ Cullapanthako'[^118-22] ti paṭhamaṃ vadati

##### *[PTS Page 119]*

taṃ hatthe gaṇha, avasesā antaradhāyissantīti". So tathā akāsi. Tāvad eva sahassamattā bhikkhū antaradhāyiṃsu. Thero gatena purisena saddhiṃ agamāsi. Satthā bhattakiccapariyosāne Jīvakaṃ āmantesi: "Jīvaka, Cullapanthakassa[^119-1] pattaṃ gaṇha, ayan[^119-2] te anumodanaṃ karissatīti". Jīvako tathā akāsi. Thero sīhanādaṃ nadanto[^119-3] taruṇasīho viya tīhi Piṭakehi saṃkhobhetvā anumodanaṃ akāsi. Satthā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhikkhusaṃghaparivāro vihāraṃ gantvā bhikkhūhi vatte dassite utthāyāsanā gandhakuṭipamukhe ṭhatvā bhikkhusaṃghassa Sugatovādaṃ datvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathetvā bhikkhusaṃghaṃ uyyojetvā surabhigandhavāsitaṃ[^119-4] gandhakuṭiṃ pavisitvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ upagato. Atha sāyaṇhasamaye dhammasabhāyaṃ bhikkhū ito c'; ito ca samosaritvā rattakambalasāṇiṃ parikkhipantā viya nisīditvā Satthu guṇakathaṃ ārabhiṃsu: "āvuso; Mahāpanthako Cullapanthakassa ajjhāsayaṃ ajānanto ‘catuhi[^119-5] māsehi ekaṃ gāthaṃ gaṇhituṃ na sakkoti, dandho ayan'; ti vihārā nikkaḍḍhi, Sammāsambuddho pana attano anuttaradhammarājatāya ekasmiṃ yev'; assa antarabhatte saha paṭisambhidāya[^119-6] arahattaṃ adāsi, tīṇi Piṭakāni paṭisambhidāhi yeva āgatāni[^119-7], aho Buddhānaṃ balan[^119-8] nāma mahantan" ti. Atha Bhagavā dhammasabhāyaṃ imaṃ kathāpavattiṃ ñatvā "ajja mayā gantuṃ vaṭṭatīti[^119-9]" Buddhaseyyāya uṭṭhāya surattadupaṭṭaṃ nivāsetvā vijjullatā viya kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā rattakambalasadisaṃ Sugatamahācīvaraṃ pārupitvā[^119-10] surabhigandhakuṭito nikkhamma mattavaravāraṇasīhavikkantavilāsena[^119-11] anantāya Buddhalīḷhāya dhammasabhāyaṃ gantvā alaṃkatamaṇḍapamajjhe supaññattavarabuddhāsanaṃ[^119-12] abhiruyha chabbaṇṇabuddharasmiyo vissajjento aṇṇavakucchiṃ obhāsayamāno Yugandharamatthake bālasuriyo viya āsanamajjhe nisīdi. Sammāsambuddhe pana āgatamatte bhikkhusaṃgho kathaṃ pacchinditvā tuṇhī ahosi. Satthā mudukena mettacittena parisaṃ oloketvā "ayaṃ parisā ativiya sobhati, ekassa[^119-13] pi hatthakukkuccaṃ vā pādakukkuccaṃ vā ukkāsitasaddo vā khipitasaddo vā n'; atthi, sabbe p'; ime Buddhagāravena sagāravā Buddhatejena tajjitā mayi āyukappam pi akathetvā nisinne paṭhamaṃ kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpetvā na kathessanti, kathāsamuṭṭhāpanavattan nāma mayā va jānitabbaṃ, aham eva paṭhamaṃ kathessāmīti madhurena brahmassarena bhikkhū āmantetvā "kāya nu 'ttha

##### *[PTS Page 120]*

bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā[^120-1] ti āha. "Bhante, na mayaṃ imasmiṃ ṭhāne nisinnā aññaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathema, tumhākaṃ yeva pana guṇe vaṇṇayamānā[^120-2] nisinn'; amhā" 'ti, "āvuso, Mahāpanthako Cullapanthakassa ajjhāsayaṃ ajānanto --pe-- aho Buddhānaṃ balan nāma mahantan" ti. Satthā bhikkhūnaṃ kathaṃ sutvā "bhikkhave, Cullapanthako maṃ nissāya idāni tāva dhammesu dhammamahantataṃ patto, pubbe pana maṃ nissāya bhogesu pi bhogamahantataṃ pāpuṇīti" āha. Bhikkhū tass' atthassa āvibhāvatthaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yāciṃsu. Bhagavā bhavantarena paṭicchannaṃ kāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi: Atīte Kāsiraṭṭhe Bārāṇasiyaṃ Brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente Bodhisatto seṭṭhikule nibbattitvā vayappatto seṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ labhitvā Cullakaseṭṭhi[^120-3] nāma ahosi. So paṇḍito vyatto sabbanimittāni jānāti. So ekadivasaṃ rājūpaṭṭhānaṃ gacchanto antaravīthiyaṃ matamūsikaṃ disvā taṃkhaṇe nakkhattaṃ samānetvā idam āha: "sakkā[^120-4] cakkhumatā kulaputtena imaṃ unduraṃ gahetvā dārābharaṇaṃ vā[^120-3] kātuṃ kammante ca[^120-5] payojetun" ti. Aññataro duggatakulaputto taṃ seṭṭhissa vacanaṃ sutvā "nāyaṃ ajānitvā[^120-6] kathessatīti" mūsikaṃ gahetvā ekasmiṃ āpaṇe[^120-7] biḷālass'; atthāya datvā kākaṇikaṃ[^120-8] labhi. Tāya kākaṇikāya[^120-8] phāṇitaṃ[^120-9] gahetvā ekena kuṭena pānīyaṃ[^120-10] gaṇhi. So araññato[^120-11] āgacchante {mālakāre}[^120-12] disvā thokaṃ thokaṃ phāṇitakhaṇḍaṃ[^120-13] datvā uluṃkena pānīyaṃ[^120-14] adāsi. Te tassa ekekaṃ pupphamuṭṭhiṃ adaṃsu. So tena pupphamūlena punadivase pi phāṇitañ[^120-15] ca pānīyaghaṭañ ca gahetvā pupphārāmam eva gato. Tassa taṃ divasaṃ mālākārā[^120-16] aḍḍhocitake[^120-17] pupphagacche datvā agamaṃsu. So na cirass'; eva iminā upāyena aṭṭha kahāpaṇe labhi. Puna ekasmiṃ vātavuṭṭhidivase rājuyyāne bahū[^120-18] sukkhadaṇḍakā ca sākhā ca palāsañ ca vātena patitaṃ hoti. Uyyānapālo chaḍḍetuṃ[^120-19] upāyaṃ na

<a id="page-121"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 121]*

passati. So tattha gantvā "sace imāni dārupaṇṇāni mayhaṃ dassasi ahan[^121-1] te imāni sabbāni nīharissāmīti" uyyānapālaṃ āha. So "gaṇha ayyā" 'ti sampaṭicchi. Cullantevāsiko dārakānaṃ keḷimaṇḍalaṃ[^121-2] gantvā phāṇitaṃ[^121-3] datvā muhuttena sabbāni dārupaṇṇāni nīharāpetvā uyyānadvāre rāsiṃ kāresi[^121-4]. Tadā rājakumbhakāro rājakulānaṃ bhājanānaṃ pacanatthāya dārūni pariyesamāno uyyānadvāre tāni disvā tassa hatthato vikkiṇitvā gaṇhi. Taṃ divasaṃ Cullantevāsiko dāruvikkayena soḷasa kahāpaṇe cāṭiādīni ca pañca bhājanāṇi[^121-5] labhi. So catuvīsatiyā kahāpaṇesu jātesu "atthi ayaṃ upāyo mayhan" ti nagaradvārato avidūraṭṭhāne ekaṃ pānīyacāṭiṃ ṭhapetvā pañcasate tiṇahārake pānīyena upaṭṭhahi. Te āhaṃsu: "tvaṃ samma amhākaṃ bahūpakāro[^121-6], kin[^121-7] te karomā" 'ti. So "mayhaṃ kicce uppanne karissathā" 'ti vatvā ito c'; ito ca[^121-8] vicaranto thalapathakammikena ca jalapathakammikena[^121-9] ca saddhiṃ mittasanthavaṃ akāsi. Tassa thalapathakammiko "sve[^121-10] imaṃ nagaraṃ assavāṇijako[^121-11] pañca assasatāni gahetvā āgamissatīti" ācikkhi. So tassa vacanaṃ sutvā tiṇahārake āha: "ajja mayhaṃ ekekaṃ tiṇakalāpaṃ detha, mayā ca tiṇe avikkīte[^121-12] attano tiṇaṃ mā vikkiṇathā" 'ti. Te "sādhū" 'ti sampaṭicchitvā pañca tiṇakalāpasatāni āharitvā tassa ghare pātayiṃsu. Assavāṇijo[^121-11] sakalanagare assānaṃ tiṇaṃ[^121-13] alabhitvā tassa sahassaṃ datvā taṃ tiṇaṃ gaṇhi. Tato katipāhaccayena tassa[^121-14] jalapathakammikasahāyako ārocesi: "paṭṭanaṃ mahānāvā āgatā" ti. So "atthi ayaṃ upāyo" ti aṭṭhahi kahāpaṇehi sabbaparivārasampannaṃ[^121-15] tāvakālikaṃ[^121-16] rathaṃ gahetvā mahantena yasena nāvāpaṭṭanaṃ gantvā ekaṃ aṅgulimuddikaṃ nāvāya saccakāraṃ datvā avidūraṭṭhāne sāṇiṃ parikkhipāpetvā nisinno purise āṇāpesi: "bāhirato vāṇijesu[^121-11] āgatesu tatiyena pāṭihārena[^121-17]

##### *[PTS Page 122]*

ārocethā" 'ti. "Nāvā āgatā" ti sutvā Bārāṇasito satamattā[^122-1] vāṇijā "bhaṇḍaṃ gaṇhāmā" 'ti āgamiṃsu. "Bhaṇḍaṃ tumhe na labhissatha, asukaṭṭhāne nāma mahāvāṇijena saccakāro dinno" ti. Te taṃ[^122-2] sutvā tassa santikaṃ āgatā. Pādamūlikapurisā purimasaññāvasena tatiyena pāṭihārena tesaṃ[^122-3] āgatabhāvaṃ ārocesuṃ. Te satamattāpi[^122-4] vāṇijā ekekaṃ sahassaṃ datvā tena saddhiṃ nāvāya paṭṭikā hutvā puna ekekaṃ sahassaṃ datvā pattiṃ vissajjāpetvā bhaṇḍaṃ attano santakaṃ akaṃsu. Cullantevāsiko dve satasahassāni gaṇhitvā Bārāṇasiṃ āgantvā "kataññunā[^122-5] bhavituṃ[^122-6] vaṭṭatīti" ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā[^122-7] Cullakaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato. Atha naṃ seṭṭhi[^122-8] "kin te tāta katvā idaṃ dhanaṃ laddhan" ti pucchi. So "tumhe[^122-9] kathitaupāye ṭhatvā catumāsabbhantaren'; eva laddhan" ti matamūsikaṃ ādiṃ katvā sabbaṃ vatthuṃ kathesi. Cullamahāseṭṭhi[^122-8] tassa vacanaṃ sutvā "na dāni evarūpaṃ dārakaṃ parasantakaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatīti[^122-10]" vayappattaṃ dhītaraṃ datvā sakalakuṭumbassa sāmikaṃ akāsi[^122-11]. So seṭṭhino accayena tasmiṃ nagare seṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ labhi. Bodhisatto pi yathākammaṃ agamāsi. Sammāsambuddho pi imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ kathetvā abhisambuddho va imaṃ gāthaṃ kathesi:

Ja_I,1.4(=4).1: Appakena pi medhāvī[^122-12] pābhatena vicakkhaṇo samuṭṭhāpeti attānaṃ anuṃ aggīva santhaman ti. ||  
Ja_I:4 ||  

Tattha appakena pīti thokenāpi parittakenāpi, medhāvīti paññavā[^122-13], pābhatenā 'ti bhaṇḍamūlena, vicakkhaṇo ti vohārakusalo[^122-14], samuṭṭhāpeti attānan ti mahantaṃ dhanañ ca yasañ ca[^122-15] uppādetvā tattha attānaṃ saṇṭhapeti[^122-16] patiṭṭhāpeti, yathā kim: aṇuṃ aggiva santhamaṃ, yathā paṇḍito puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ anukkamena gomayacuṇṇādīni pakkhipitvā mukhavātena[^122-17] dhamanto samuṭṭhāpeti vaḍḍheti mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ karoti evam eva paṇḍito thokam pi pābhataṃ labhitvā nānāupāyehi payojetvā dhanañ ca yasañ ca[^122-18]

vaḍḍheti vaḍḍhetvā ca pana tattha attānaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti, tāya eva vā pana dhanayasamahantatāya attānaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, abhiññātaṃ[^123-1] pākaṭaṃ karotīti attho. Iti Bhagavā "bhikkhave, Cullapanthako maṃ nissāya idāni dhammesu dhammamahantataṃ patto, pubbe pana bhogesu pi bhogamahantataṃ pāpuṇīti". Evaṃ imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ dassetvā dve vatthūni kathetvā anusandhiṃ ghaṭetvā jātakaṃ samodhānesi: "Tadā Cullantevāsiko Cullapanthako ahosi, Cullakamahāseṭṭhi[^123-2] pana aham eva ahosin" ti desanaṃ niṭṭhapesi. Cullakaseṭṭhijātakaṃ[^123-3].

5. Taṇḍulanālijātaka. Kim agghati taṇḍulanālikā ti. Idaṃ Satthā Jetavane viharanto Lāḷudāyittheraṃ[^123-4] ārabbha kathesi. Tasmiṃ samaye āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto saṃghassa bhattuddesako hoti. Tasmiṃ pāto va salākabhattāni uddisamāne[^123-5] Udāyittherassa[^123-6] kadāci varabhattaṃ pāpuṇāti[^123-7] kadāci lāmakabhattaṃ. So lāmakabhattassa pattadivase salākaggaṃ[^123-8] ākulaṃ karoti: "kiṃ Dabbo va[^123-9] salākaṃ dātuṃ jānāti, amhe na jānāmā" 'ti[^123-10] vadati. Tasmiṃ salākaggaṃ ākulaṃ karonte "handa dāni tvam eva salākā dehīti" salākapacchiṃ adaṃsu. Tato paṭṭhāya so saṃghassa salākaṃ adāsi, dadanto pana idaṃ varabhattan ti vā lāmakabhattan ti vā asukavassagge varabhattaṃ ṭhitaṃ asukavassagge lāmakabhattan ti vā na jānāti, ṭhitikaṃ karonto pi asukavassagge ṭhitikā ti na sallakkheti, bhikkhūnaṃ ṭhitavelāya imasmiṃ ṭhāne ayaṃ ṭhitikā ṭhitā imasmiṃ ṭhāne[^123-11] ayan ti bhūmiyaṃ vā bhittiyaṃ vā lekhaṃ kaḍḍhati[^123-12]. Punadivase salākagge bhikkhū mandatarā vā honti bahutarā vā, tesu mandataresu lekhā heṭṭhā hoti bahutaresu upari, so ṭhitikaṃ ajānanto lekhāsaññāya[^123-13] salākaṃ deti. Atha naṃ bhikkhū "āvuso Udāyi[^123-14] lekhā nāma heṭṭhā vā hoti[^123-15] upari vā, varabhattaṃ pana asukavassagge ṭhitaṃ lāmakabhattaṃ asukavassagge" ti āhaṃsu. So bhikkhū[^123-16] paṭippharanto "yadi evaṃ ayaṃ lekhā kasmā evaṃ ṭhitā, kiṃ ahaṃ tumhākaṃ saddahāmi, imissā lekhāya saddahāmīti" vadati, Atha naṃ daharā ca sāmaṇerā[^123-17] ca "āvuso

##### *[PTS Page 124]*

Lāḷudāyi[^124-1], tayi salākā[^124-2] dente bhikkhū lābhena parihāyanti, na tvaṃ dātuṃ anucchaviko, niggaccha ito" ti salākaggato nikkaḍḍhiṃsu. Tasmiṃ khaṇe salākagge mahantaṃ kolāhalaṃ ahosi. Taṃ sutvā Satthā Anandattheraṃ[^124-3] pucchi: "Ānanda, salākagge mahantaṃ kolāhalaṃ, kiṃsaddo nām'; eso" ti. Thero Tathāgatassa tam atthaṃ ārocesi. "Ananda, na idān'; eva Udāyi[^124-4] attano bālatāya paresaṃ lābhahāniṃ karoti, pubbe pi akāsi yevā" 'ti āha. Thero tass'; atthassa āvibhāvatthaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yāci. Bhagavā bhavantarena paṭicchannaṃ kāraṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ akāsi: Atīte Kāsiraṭṭhe Bārāṇasiyaṃ Brahmadatto rājā ahosi. Tadā amhākaṃ Bodhisatto tassa agghakārako ahosi, hatthiassādīni c'; eva maṇisuvaṇṇādīni ca agghāpeti, agghāpetvā bhaṇḍasāmikānaṃ[^124-5] bhaṇḍānurūpam eva mūlaṃ dāpesi. Rājā pana luddho hoti, so lobhapakatiyā[^124-6] evaṃ cintesi: "ayaṃ agghāpanako evaṃ agghāpento na cirass'; eva mama gehe dhanaṃ parikkhayaṃ gamissati[^124-4], aññaṃ[^124-7] agghāpanakaṃ karissāmīti" so sīhapañjaraṃ ugghāṭetvā rājaṅgaṇaṃ olokento ekaṃ gāmikamanussaṃ lolabālaṃ rājaṅgaṇena gacchantaṃ disvā "esa mayhaṃ agghāpanakakammaṃ kātuṃ sakkhissatīti" taṃ pakkosāpetvā "sakkhissasi bhaṇe amhākaṃ agghāpanakakammaṃ[^124-8] kātun" ti āha. "Sakkhissāmi devā" 'ti. Rājā attano dhanarakkhaṇatthāya[^124-9] taṃ bālaṃ agghāpanakakamme[^124-10] ṭhapesi. Tato paṭṭhāya so bālo hatthiassādīni agghāpento agghaṃ hāpetvā yathāruciyā[^124-11] katheti, tassa ṭhānantare ṭhitattā yaṃ so katheti tam eva mūlaṃ hoti. Tasmiṃ kāle uttarāpathato eko assavāṇijo[^124-12] pañca assasatāni ānesi. Rājā taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā asse agghāpesi. So pañcannaṃ assasatānaṃ ekaṃ taṇḍulanālikaṃ[^124-13] aggham akāsi, katvā ca pana "assavāṇijassa[^124-14] ekaṃ taṇḍulanālikaṃ[^124-13] dethā" 'ti vatvā asse assa-
